evidence.readmeExcerpt: # dsh-claude-data A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that adds the **claude-data** skill from [baoyu-design](https://github.com/JimLiu/baoyu-design): the agent builds data-backed dashboards (charts, numbers and tables over your CSV, TSV or JSON files, or data it gathers) as files in your workspace and opens them in a local dashboard editor, with a Sources panel that shows where every number comes from. ## Install In the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → enter `dsh-claude-data` in **Package name or address** → **Install**, and turn the plugin on. From the command line, for a CLI profile such as `web`: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-claude-data ``` Then start a new session and ask for a dashboard, or type `/claude-data`. A workspace that has its own `claude-data` skill (in `.agents/skills/` or `.dsh/skills/`) uses that copy instead of this plugin's. To update, uninstall the plugin, install it again, and quit and reopen the app. For a day after a release the app's package manager (pnpm) still picks the previous version; to get the new one sooner, enter the name with the version, such as `dsh-claude-data@2.4.0`. ## What is inside - `skills/claude-data/`: the skill as baoyu-design publishes it (`SKILL.md`, `artifact-type/reference/`, and the prebuilt `scripts/`: the editor page and `artifact.mjs`, which is also its server). - `lib/index.js`: the plugin. It registers the skill with the Harness skill registry and, when the skill loads, tells the agent which Node executable runs `scripts/artifact.mjs`: the Host's own Node, the Node runtime the desktop app ships, or `node` on PATH. Set `node` in the `claude-data` row's config to choose another. That is all this row does, so you can turn it off and [keep the skill to one agent preset](https://github.com/JimLiu/baoyu-design/blob/main/dsh-plugins/README.md#keep-a-skill-to-one-preset). - `cordis.patch.yml`: the bundle layer that mounts two rows: this plugin's, and its row of `dsh-claude-artifacts`. [`dsh-claude-artifacts`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-artifacts) installs with this plugin and does the rest, whichever way the skill is set up: whenever the agent opens the editor it waits for comments, so a comment's **Send to Agent** box is there: send one and the agent wakes up, changes the dashboard, and replies in the comment. It shows what is sent as a card in the chat, and adds **Artifacts** to the left sidebar, one entry for all the baoyu-design plugins: the dashboards and everything else the agent has opened, each a click away from its conversation and editor. The editor server listens on 127.0.0.1 only and reads and writes only the dashboard's folder. ## License Not all MIT. The plugin's own code and files (`lib/`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `locale/`, `docs/`, `icon.svg`) and the skill's local tooling are MIT, in `LICENSE`. The bundled `claude-data` skill is adapted from Anthropic's claude.ai Dashboard type: its instructions, references, page and icon fonts stay Anthropic's and are not under the MIT License. `NOTICE.md` sets out which is which. The page's open-source licenses are in `skills/claude-data/scripts/editor/third-party-licenses.txt`. # baoyu-design https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d5b4f39b-a701-49de-87b8-64f3c6ef9c61 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/84ddf462-5ac6-44c6-a175-05a7ccaa019e https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/db6c5d93-dc28-4170-8356-4dbe5725a57c **Run Claude Design on your own local agent — Cursor, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, or any file‑capable coding agent.** [English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) [![License: MIT for own code, see NOTICE](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT%20for%20own%20code%20%C2%B7%20see%20NOTICE-blue.svg)](NOTICE.md) ![Best with Opus 5.5](https://img.shields.io/badge/Best%20with-Opus%205.5-d97757) ![Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/Cursor%20%C2%B7%20Claude%20Code%20%C2%B7%20Codex-supported-1f6feb) This repo brings claude.ai's **Artifact types** to local agents: editable slide decks, design canvases, design systems, data dashboards, motion films and whiteboards, each opened in its own editor that runs on your machine. `motion-director` directs those films, from the point of the film to the finished cut. `dataviz` is the chart guide the agent reads before it draws any chart, in these skills or anywhere else. The six editors also ship as [DeepSeek Harness plugins](#deepseek-harness-plugins), installed from npm by name. The original `baoyu-design` skill (self‑contained HTML mockups and prototypes) has been archived to [`archive/baoyu-design/`](archive/baoyu-design/). No website, no separate subscription, no upload step. The agent already on your machine does the work, and every artifact stays in your repo. --- ## Skills in this repo | Skill | Makes | You edit it in | |---|---|---| | [`claude-slides`](skills/claude-slides/) | Slide decks: `project/deck.json` plus one HTML file per slide | The slides editor: present, retype, drag; export PDF, HTML or PowerPoint | | [`claude-design`](skills/claude-design/) | A canvas of artboards: `project/canvas.json` plus `.dc.html` Design Components | The canvas editor: artboards side by side, play prototypes, retype copy, adjust tweaks; export HTML, PDF, PNG or HTML for Figma | | [`claude-design-system`](skills/claude-design-system/) | Design systems: tokens, a README brand book, component previews, fonts, asset groups | The design system editor: browse and edit colors, type, components and assets | | [`claude-data`](skills/claude-data/) | Data‑backed dashboards: datasets (CSV, TSV, JSON) and a page of charts, numbers and tables over them | The dashboard page: live charts, filters, and a Sources panel that traces every number to its rows | | [`claude-motion`](skills/claude-motion/) | Motion films: animated videos, 10–30 s unless you ask for more and 15 minutes at most, written as code scene by scene into the film's own store under `/db/` | The Motion player: watch it fill in, retype lines, drag scene lengths, adjust style and tweaks; export MP4 or GIF | | [`motion-director`](skills/motion-director/) | A finished film with something to say: it finds the point, writes the narration for the ear, has it voiced, times every scene to the words, and checks the frames as a viewer would. Needs `claude-motion` beside it | The same Motion player, open from the first minute | | [`claude-whiteboard`](skills/claude-whiteboard/) | Whiteboards: diagrams, flows, maps of ideas, plans and comparisons, written as elements (blocks, sections, arrows, tables, sticky notes, drawings, working embeds) into the board's own store under `/db/` | The board editor: move, resize, type, draw with the pen, add sections, sticky notes, shapes and stickers, drop in videos; export PNG | | [`dataviz`](skills/dataviz/) | Better charts in any medium (HTML, SVG, d3, matplotlib, plotly…): picking the form, colors that stay readable in light and dark and for color‑blind readers, marks, legends and tooltips, with a palette validator script | Nothing to open: the agent reads it before writing chart code; swap [`palette.md`](skills/dataviz/references/palette.md) for your brand's colors | --- ## Artifact skills: editable decks, canvases, design systems, dashboards, films and whiteboards These six skills write the Artifact type's own file format into a folder and open it in that type's editor page, served from your machine. The agent writes the files and the editor shows each write at once; your edits in the editor are saved back into the same files, so you and the agent can take turns. In the slides, canvas and design-system editors and on the dashboard page, choose **Comment** (or press **C**) to comment on an element or area; in the Motion player, its **Comment** button comments on a moment of the film; on a whiteboard, the comments button comments on an item, a spot or an area. Comments stay in the project's local `comments.json`; the agent reads and replies through `artifact.mjs`. While it listens with `comments --wait`, the editor offers **Send to Agent** to send your comment for it to act on, and the page's own buttons that ask the agent for something (**Ask the agent to fix** on a slide or canvas that can't be shown, the design system's setup buttons, the dashboard's **Ask the agent**) send it their request the same way. To work together, `share ` (or `open --lan`) opens the deck, canvas, design system, dashboard, film or board to your local network, the same Wi‑Fi or LAN, and prints a link per role: **editor** edits and comments, **commenter** comments without editing, **viewer** only looks. Whoever opens a link types a name and is in; what they change shows on everyone's page, and their comments land in the same `comments.json`. The person at this computer is the owner: the **Share** button lists who joined and who is online, changes someone's role or removes them, and turns each link off, back on or resets it. Guests get a Share button too, with the links they may pass on: their own role's and those below it. There is no account and nothing leaves your network; it is plain http, so anyone there with a link gets in. Every change is kept as a version, with who made it: a guest by the name they typed, the owner, or **Agent** for a change made to the files on this computer. The **History** button (the clock beside Share) lists the versions by day; open one to see which slides, artboards or documents it changed, line by line, preview the whole thing as it was, or restore it (or just one part) as a new version, so nothing is lost. When two people save the same slide at once, the later save no longer wipes out the earlier one unnoticed: the version records whose change it replaced, and both people get a notice with **Compare** and **Bring back**, which puts back only what was replaced and leaves the other person's other changes. In the slides, design and design-system editors, someone else's save updates your page in place instead of reloading it, and if they saved the slide, artboard or file you have unsaved edits on, a bar asks whether to use theirs, keep yours, or keep both (yours becomes a new slide after it, an artboard beside it, or a copy of the file). The two are first merged: on a canvas element by element, in slides and design-system files line by line (a token file token by token). When you changed different elements or lines, both changes stay and nothing asks; the bar comes up only when the merge cannot sort it out, such as both changing the same line. The history lives in the project's `history/` folder. While others have the page open, their avatars sit beside History. In the slides and canvas editors each one's card says which slide or artboard they are on and whether they are editing, and their cursors and selections show where they work; when someone starts editing what you are looking at, you get a short note, and nothing is ever locked. While Claude changes the files, it shows up there too. To back a project up, move it to another computer or hand it to someone, the owner's **Whole folder (.zip)** item, last in the Share panel's Export tab (the owner's: guests can pass a link on but not export), downloads the whole folder as one zip, its history and comments included; `artifact.mjs archive ` does the same from the command line. Unzip it anywhere and `open` it with the same skill to carry on. This computer's server state and the share links are left out, so a copy you send is not shared until its new owner shares it. ### `claude-slides`: slide decks A deck is `project/deck.json` plus one HTML file per slide. In the editor you can present full screen, retype any text, drag elements, add text, images, tables and shapes, and export to PDF, HTML or PowerPoint. A video added by link plays in its provider's player, and the agent can upload a clip for a slide. *Above: a five‑slide health class deck about sleep, built on a sample design system.* ### `claude-design`: a canvas of artboards A canvas holds artboards side by side: `project/canvas.json` plus one `.dc.html` Design Component per artboard. Play an artboard as a working prototype, on the canvas or full screen; retype copy, adjust tweaks and leave notes; export the whole design as a standalone HTML page, a PDF or PNG images (1× or 2×, several artboards in a .zip); **HTML for Figma** saves the artboards as a page without frames, for Figma's Chrome extension to capture. Full window, an artboard lays out at a screen width you pick (phone, tablet or desktop sizes), and its Export saves the whole page at that width as a PNG. *Above: the landing hero of a coffee subscription, with its mobile signup form beside it.* ### `claude-design-system`: design systems A design system is tokens, a README brand book, component previews, fonts and asset groups. In the editor you browse and edit colors, type, spacing, radii, shadows, components and assets. Import one from a component library and its previews are the real components, live and interactive. Decks and canvases can install it: their editors' Theme and color menus then offer its colors and text styles. *Above: Nimbus, a small design system for a weather app.* ### `claude-data`: data‑backed dashboards A dashboard is datasets (CSV, TSV or JSON) and a page of charts, numbers and tables computed from them. The charts are live, and the Sources panel traces every number back to its rows. Give the agent a newer export and it swaps the file in; the page recomputes every number. Numbers, dates and labels follow your language. *Above: a year of daily X account analytics, with sample data.* ### `claude-motion`: motion films A film is a folder of documents the agent writes with the skill's script, scene by scene, while you watch it fill in the player. Everything on screen is code, a pure function of time, so a change is a rewrite of that moment, not a re-render you wait for. Retype a line, drag a scene's length, change the style in **Tweaks** or a line's weight, size, spacing and color there, or comment on a moment and send it to the agent. A narrated film carries a voice track: one take a scene, from a speech provider of yours or recorded by you, with the motion timed to the words and captions that follow them; a recorded track can play as the music bed. Export MP4 or GIF from the player, or `export` from the command line (Chrome needed; `record`, for filming a page of your own product, also needs ffmpeg). For a film with a point to make, ask for `motion-director`, which directs and uses `claude-motion` as its crew. *Above: the film that introduces Motion, made with Motion.* ### `claude-whiteboard`: whiteboards A board is a space for laying out thinking in the form it needs: a diagram, a flow, a map of ideas, a plan, a comparison, a drawn explanation or a small working embed. The agent writes it as elements (blocks, sections, text, arrows, tables, sticky notes, drawings and embeds) into the board's own store with the skill's script, and the editor shows each one as it lands. Move and resize things, type, draw with the pen, add sections, sticky notes, shapes and stickers from the toolbar, and drop a video on the board to play there; what you change goes into the same store. Comment on an item, a spot or an area and send it to the agent, which changes the board and replies. Everyone on a share link sees the others' cursors and changes live, has cursor chat and can follow one another's view. The **Share** panel's **Export** tab saves the board as a PNG. One server serves every board on this computer. *Above: a board that explains how a change ships.* ### Run the editors Each `SKILL.md` keeps the type's original instructions nearly word for word; only the Artifact tool calls are swapped for local ones. That tool lives inside each skill as `scripts/artifact.mjs` (Node 20+, the dashboard's, Motion's and the whiteboard's Node 22+; nothing to install). The agent runs it for you; by hand: ```bash node skills/claude-slides/scripts/artifact.mjs open designs/q3-review # start the editor, print its URL node skills/claude-slides/scripts/artifact.mjs check designs/q3-review # validate the files node skills/claude-slides/scripts/artifact.mjs upload designs/q3-review hero.jpg # store an image, print its /_blob/ URL node skills/claude-slides/scripts/artifact.mjs list # find design systems on disk node skills/claude-slides/scripts/artifact.mjs share designs/q3-review # open it to the local network, print a link per role ``` A dashboard, a film or a board is written through the same script (`write-db`, `read-db`, `upload`, `check`, `open`) into its own store under `/db/`. Each skill runs its own local server, and everything in `scripts/` ships prebuilt: plain JavaScript that runs on Node alone, with nothing to install or build. --- ## DeepSeek Harness plugins The six editor skills also come as [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugins, published on npm. Each plugin carries its skill exactly as this repo publishes it, prebuilt editor included, so Claude Design and the other editors run on your DeepSeek agent. | npm package | Adds | Version | |---|---|---| | [`dsh-claude-slides`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-slides) | `/claude-slides`: slide decks | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-claude-slides)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-slides) | | [`dsh-claude-design`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-design) | `/claude-design`: a canvas of artboards | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-claude-design)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-design) | | [`dsh-claude-design-system`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-design-system) | `/claude-design-system`: design systems | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-claude-design-system)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-design-system) | | [`dsh-claude-data`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-data) | `/claude-data`: data‑backed dashboards | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-claude-data)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-data) | | [`dsh-claude-motion`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-motion) | `/claude-motion`: motion films | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-claude-motion)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-motion) | | [`dsh-claude-whiteboard`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-whiteboard) | `/claude-whiteboard`: whiteboards | [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-claude-whiteboard)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-whiteboard) | In the slides, canvas and design-system editors, on the dashboard page, in the Motion player and on a whiteboard, a comment goes straight to the agent: whenever the agent opens an editor, the plugin waits for comments. Mark up the page, tick **Send to Agent**, and the agent wakes up, reads your comment, makes the change and replies in the comment thread. The comment also shows in the chat as a card. The plugins also add **Artifacts** to the app's left sidebar: every deck, canvas, design system, dashboard, film and board the agent has opened, each with a thumbnail, as a grid or a list, with search, sort and filters. Click one and the app goes back to the conversation that made it and opens the editor in the right sidebar. A tile at the top starts a new session with the input filled in for that kind of thing, so the right skill loads. ### Install from npm All you need is the DeepSeek Harness desktop app: no repo to clone, nothing to build. The app downloads the plugin from npm (or from the npmmirror registry when npm is out of reach) and runs it on the Node.js it ships with. 1. In the app, open **Plugins** → **Add plugin**. 2. Enter a package name from the table, such as `dsh-claude-design`, in **Package name or address**, and click **Install**. If the plugin's switch is off, turn it on. Repeat for each plugin you want. 3. Quit and reopen the app, then start a new session and ask for a deck, a canvas, a design system, a dashboard, a film or a whiteboard, or type `/claude-design` (`/claude-slides` and so on). To install into a CLI profile, such as `web`: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-claude-design ``` **From the Discover tab.** The app's experimental Discover tab can list the plugins, install them with a click and show when an update is out. On the Plugins page, click **More** beside **Experimental plugins** and switch on **Custom plugin markets**; then in **Discover**, click **Add index source** and add this index: ```text https://jimliu.github.io/baoyu-design/dsh-plugins/index.json ``` **Updating.** When a new version is out, the **Artifacts** row in the sidebar gets an **Update** label, and the top of the Artifacts page says what changed: **Update all** updates the plugins together, with nothing to uninstall, and each plugin has its own **Update** if you want just one. Versions 2.9.2 and earlier don't offer it: from DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2, click **Update to x** on the plugin's page. On older apps, uninstall the plugin on the Plugins page, install it again, then quit and reopen the app. For a day after a release, adding by name still gets the previous version; Discover gets the new one right away, and so does entering the name with the version, such as `dsh-claude-design@2.4.0` (the versions are in the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md)). Had `dsh-claude-dashboard`? It is now `dsh-claude-data`, and the Artifacts page offers the move as an update ([details](dsh-plugins/README.md#update)). Each plugin brings along [`dsh-claude-artifacts`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-artifacts), the part they share: the Artifacts page, and comments reaching the agent. To have a skill only in one agent preset, see [Keep a skill to one preset](dsh-plugins/README.md#keep-a-skill-to-one-preset). Running Harness on one computer and using it from another (`dsh web` on a server, opened on your laptop or phone)? Open your work from **Artifacts**: the plugin opens the editor at an address that device reaches, with you as its owner. See [Use it from another device](dsh-plugins/README.md#use-it-from-another-device). A workspace that has its own copy of a skill (in `.agents/skills/` or `.dsh/skills/`) uses that copy instead of the plugin's. Step by step, with installing from a folder, uninstalling and what to do when something doesn't work: [`dsh-plugins/`](dsh-plugins/README.md). --- ## ChatGPT plugins The same skills also come as plugins for the ChatGPT desktop app and Codex: [Baoyu Slides](chatgpt-plugins/baoyu-slides/), [Baoyu Canvas](chatgpt-plugins/baoyu-canvas/), [Baoyu Design System](chatgpt-plugins/baoyu-design-system/), [Baoyu Data](chatgpt-plugins/baoyu-data/), [Baoyu Motion](chatgpt-plugins/baoyu-motion/) (with `motion-director` and `dataviz`), [Baoyu Whiteboard](chatgpt-plugins/baoyu-whiteboard/) and [Baoyu Dataviz](chatgpt-plugins/baoyu-dataviz/). Add this repository as a marketplace, then install the ones you want: ```bash codex plugin marketplace add JimLiu/baoyu-design --sparse .agents/plugins --sparse chatgpt-plugins ``` ```bash codex plugin add baoyu-slides@baoyu-design ``` The editors run on your computer, so opening one needs local network, which the default sandbox blocks: approve it if the app asks, or use a permission mode that allows it. Step by step, with installing from the app's Plugins Directory and updating: [chatgpt-plugins/README.md](chatgpt-plugins/README.md). --- ## Why run it locally - **Free yourself from the website.** You get the vast majority of `claude.ai/design`'s capabilities without ever leaving your editor — same methodology, same craft standards, same output format. - **Best with Opus 5.5.** The skill is a long, demanding design brief; the stronger the model, the better the result. Pair it with **Claude Opus 5.5** for the best output, and it still works well on other capable models. - **Edit side by side with the agent.** Each editor runs on `localhost`; your edits save back into the same files the agent writes, so you can take turns. - **Work together, no cloud.** Share an editor on your local network with a link per role; others edit, comment or watch, and you decide who stays in. Version history shows who changed what and brings any version back. - **Everything is yours.** Output lands in `designs//` as plain files you can version, fork, export, or ship. --- ## Quick start Using the DeepSeek Harness app? You don't need this section: [install the plugins from npm](#install-from-npm). ### Prerequisites - A local agent — **[Cursor](https://cursor.com)**, **[Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)**, **[Codex](https://developers.openai.com/codex/)**, or any of the 70+ agents the installer supports (Cline, Roo Code, GitHub Copilot…). Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex have first‑class tool references inside the skill. - **Claude Opus 5.5** selected as the model, for best results. - **Node.js**, for the `npx` installer below and for the artifact skills' editors (Node 20+, the dashboard, Motion and the whiteboard Node 22+). ### Install **Recommended — the `skills` CLI.** [`npx skills`](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) (from Vercel Labs) reads this repo, finds the skills under `skills/`, and drops them into the right folder for whatever agent it detects: ```bash # Install into the current project (auto‑detects your agent) npx skills add JimLiu/baoyu-design # …or install globally, for every project npx skills add JimLiu/baoyu-design -g # Target a specific agent explicitly npx skills add JimLiu/baoyu-design --agent claude-code npx skills add JimLiu/baoyu-design --agent cursor npx skills add JimLiu/baoyu-design --agent codex # Just list what's in the repo first npx skills add JimLiu/baoyu-design --list # Install only some of the skills npx skills add JimLiu/baoyu-design --skill claude-slides --skill claude-data ``` It installs to `.claude/skills/` for Claude Code and `.agents/skills/` for Cursor/Codex-style agents (add `-g` for the `~/`‑level user install). ### Update If you installed with the `skills` CLI, update from the terminal: ```bash # Update one skill (the CLI prompts for the install scope) npx skills update claude-slides # Update the project-level or global install npx skills update claude-slides -p -y npx skills update claude-slides -g -y ``` `upgrade` is also supported as an alias. You can also run `npx skills update` to update all installed skills. After updating, restart Claude Code (or start a new agent session) so the refreshed skill files are loaded. **Alternative — hand the repo URL to your agent.** Don't want to install anything? Paste the URL into chat and let the agent fetch the skill itself: > Read https://github.com/JimLiu/baoyu-design and follow its `skills/claude-slides/SKILL.md` to make a 10‑slide deck from this PRD. The agent clones or fetches the repo, loads `SKILL.md`, and proceeds — perfect for a one‑off. ### Use it Once a skill is installed (or fetched), ask for what you want (*"Make a 12‑slide deck from this PRD"*, *"Turn this CSV into a dashboard"*) or call one by name: `/claude-slides`, `/claude-design`, `/claude-design-system`, `/claude-data`, `/claude-motion`, `/motion-director` or `/claude-whiteboard` in Claude Code, `$claude-slides` and so on in Codex. The agent writes the files under `designs//`, starts the editor, and gives you its `http://127.0.0.1` URL. --- ## Example prompts - *"Make a claude-slides deck for the Q3 review, then export it to PowerPoint."* - *"Put a landing page and its phone version side by side on a claude-design canvas."* - *"Turn the Chakra UI component library into a design system with live component previews."* - *"Turn this analytics CSV into a dashboard that compares the last 28 days with the 28 before."* - *"Use motion-director to turn this launch post into a 60‑second narrated film."* - *"Map out our onboarding flow on a claude-whiteboard board, with the open questions as sticky notes."* For best results, **give it design context** — a screenshot, a UI kit, a design system, or a codebase. Starting from real context is the single biggest lever on quality; the skill will ask for it if you don't provide it. --- ## Credits & license This project repackages **Anthropic**'s claude.ai Artifact types and design skills so they can run on local agents. It is an independent, community effort and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. Repackaged and maintained by **Jim Liu 宝玉**. The repository holds material under three sets of terms, set out in [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md): - **The maintainer's own work** (the local command line and editor server, the local comments, the DeepSeek Harness plugin code, the docs) is under the [MIT License

releaseNotes.en:
### Features
- **Buttons on the page that ask the agent for something now reach it.** While the agent listens with `comments <root> --wait`, such a button sends its request to the agent the way **Send to Agent** sends a comment, and the page says it was sent to the agent. `--wait` prints it under `requests`: its `text` is what is asked, and `label` and `selection` say what it is about (an `--agent-hook` command gets `{"request": …}`). In `claude-slides` it is **Ask the agent to fix** on a slide the editor can't show. In `claude-design` it is the same button on a canvas whose `project/canvas.json` can't be read, or on artboards with errors. In `claude-design-system` they are **Sync from GitHub**, **Build from connectors** and **Create design system** on an empty system, **Fix with the agent** on a contrast warning, **Finish setting up**, and **Ask the agent about this file** on an upload it refused. In `claude-data` they are **Ask the agent** on a part of the page you selected, **Ask the agent to fix** (or to limit) on queries that can't be shared, asking why sources failed, fixing a page that failed, **Make editable**, and a design-system change. With no agent listening, the slides, canvas and design-system buttons still copy their request for the chat, and the dashboard says the agent isn't listening.
- **An empty deck, canvas, film, dashboard or board shows when the agent is at work on it**, while the agent is on a comment or request it took, as on claude.ai.
- **`claude-motion`: text style controls.** In **Tweaks** in the side panel, a line of text has Weight (bold, italic), Size, Spacing (line and letter spacing) and Color, plus Align for text on several lines. A change shows on the film at once, is kept in `modules/retouched.json` and is in the frames `stills` makes. A row's **Reset** takes back that change, and **Reset all changes** takes back every change made by hand.
- **`claude-whiteboard`: videos, a PNG export, cursor chat and following.** Drop a video (mp4, mov or webm, up to 20 MB) on the board: it is uploaded and plays over its still. The agent may move or resize it but adds none, and `upload` still takes images only. The owner's **Share** panel has a **PNG** export of the board in its **Export** tab, before the whole folder. Everyone on a share link has cursor chat and can follow one another's view, **Follow me** included. Pages open on the same board now pass the board's room events to each other, so an upload in progress shows in the other people's pages too. Only asking the board's own assistant from cursor chat stays off: it needs claude.ai's model.
- **`claude-slides`: video on a slide.** A video added by link plays in its provider's player: YouTube's no-cookie player opens on a click, and Vimeo, Loom and Drive players are let in too. `upload` takes a clip for a slide (mp4 or webm, up to 20 MB), which the slide names with `data-video` on its still.

### Fixes
- `claude-motion`: after any change made by hand (a scene's length, a retyped line, a color), opening **Tweaks** in the side panel turned the whole page into "This artifact couldn't be displayed". The **Reset all changes** button at the foot of the tab read something that was never set. The button now shows and works.
- `claude-slides`: the script in a live embed (`<x-embed>`) didn't run in the editor, because the editor page's script policy blocked it. It runs now. The embed is still sandboxed and still has no network.
- `claude-whiteboard`: a commenter on a share link was taken for a viewer. **Follow me** told them view-only access can't ask others to follow, and nobody could follow them. A commenter now comments and follows like everyone else.
- `claude-whiteboard`: a face sticker by a guest who had left read "Someone's sticker" once the page was reloaded. It now keeps the guest's name, unless their link was reset or they were removed.
- `claude-data`: comment mode left Edit, Design and Sources on. Now, as on claude.ai, they are off while you comment, and the Sources panel closes.
- `claude-design-system`: **Download** in the Files panel said downloads weren't available. It now saves the file.
- `claude-design`: an artboard copied from claude.ai whose name has spaces (or other characters the local server can't write) wasn't saved when pasted. It is now saved under a name the server can write, with the old name as its title, and another pasted artboard that imports it follows the new name. The context menu's **Paste** now reads images you copied. When the browser won't let it read, it pastes the editor's own copy.

### Documentation
- The `SKILL.md` files of `claude-slides`, `claude-design`, `claude-design-system` and `claude-data` list the buttons that send the agent a request and say how one arrives. `claude-whiteboard`'s says that videos on the board are people's, and what still doesn't run.
releaseNotes.zh:
### 新功能
- **页面上向 Agent 提需求的按钮，现在能送到 Agent 那里。** Agent 用 `comments <root> --wait` 等着的时候，这类按钮会像 **Send to Agent** 发评论那样把请求发给 Agent，页面上提示已经发给 Agent。`--wait` 把它打印在 `requests` 下：`text` 是要做什么，`label` 和 `selection` 说明是关于什么的（`--agent-hook` 的命令收到的是 `{"request": …}`）。`claude-slides` 里是编辑器显示不出来的幻灯片上的 **Ask the agent to fix**。`claude-design` 里也是这个按钮，出现在读不了 `project/canvas.json` 的画布上，或者出错的画板上。`claude-design-system` 里是空设计系统上的 **Sync from GitHub**、**Build from connectors**、**Create design system**，对比度警告上的 **Fix with the agent**，**Finish setting up**，以及被拒绝的上传上的 **Ask the agent about this file**。`claude-data` 里是选中页面某一部分后的 **Ask the agent**，不能共享的查询上的 **Ask the agent to fix**（或 to limit），问数据源为什么失败，修复出错的页面，**Make editable**，以及改设计系统。没有 Agent 在等的时候，幻灯片、画布和设计系统的按钮照旧把请求复制下来，好贴进对话；仪表盘则提示 Agent 没在听。
- **空的演示稿、画布、影片、仪表盘或白板，会显示 Agent 正在处理。** Agent 接手评论或请求、还在处理时，页面会显示出来，和 claude.ai 上一样。
- **`claude-motion`：文字样式控件。** 侧栏 **Tweaks** 里，一行字有 Weight（粗体、斜体）、Size、Spacing（行距、字距）和 Color，多行的字还有 Align。改了影片上马上变，记在 `modules/retouched.json` 里，`stills` 出的帧里也是改过的样子。每一行的 **Reset** 撤回那一项，**Reset all changes** 撤回所有手动的改动。
- **`claude-whiteboard`：视频、PNG 导出、光标聊天和跟随。** 把视频（mp4、mov 或 webm，最大 20 MB）拖到白板上：它会被上传，在自己的封面图上播放。Agent 可以挪动、缩放它，但不会加视频，`upload` 仍然只收图片。白板主人的 **Share** 面板里，**Export** 标签多了一项 **PNG**，排在整个文件夹之前，导出整块白板。拿到分享链接的人都能用光标聊天，也能跟随彼此的视角，包括 **Follow me**。同一块白板上开着的几个页面，现在会互相转发白板的房间事件，所以有人正在上传时，别人的页面上也看得到。只有在光标聊天里问白板自带的助手仍然关着：它要用 claude.ai 的模型。
- **`claude-slides`：幻灯片上的视频。** 用链接加的视频在它自己网站的播放器里播放：点一下打开 YouTube 的无 cookie 播放器，Vimeo、Loom 和 Drive 的播放器也放行了。`upload` 能为幻灯片上传视频片段（mp4 或 webm，最大 20 MB），幻灯片在封面图上用 `data-video` 指向它。

### 修复
- `claude-motion`：只要手动改过一处（场景长度、改过的台词、颜色），再打开侧栏的 **Tweaks**，整个页面就变成 "This artifact couldn't be displayed"。原因是标签页底部的 **Reset all changes** 按钮读了一个从没设置过的东西。现在按钮能正常显示和使用。
- `claude-slides`：实时嵌入（`<x-embed>`）里的脚本在编辑器里不运行，因为编辑器页面的脚本策略拦住了它。现在能运行，嵌入仍然在沙箱里，也照样不能联网。
- `claude-whiteboard`：分享链接上有评论权限的人被当成了只能查看的人。**Follow me** 提示只读权限不能让别人跟随，别人也跟随不了他们。现在他们和其他人一样能评论、能跟随。
- `claude-whiteboard`：已经离开的访客贴的表情贴纸，页面刷新后显示 "Someone's sticker"。现在会保留访客的名字，除非重置了他们的链接或者移除了他们。
- `claude-data`：进入评论模式后，Edit、Design、Sources 仍然可用。现在和 claude.ai 上一样，评论时它们都关掉，Sources 面板也会收起。
- `claude-design-system`：Files 面板里的 **Download** 提示无法下载。现在能把文件存下来。
- `claude-design`：从 claude.ai 复制的画板，名字里有空格（或本地服务器写不了的字符）时，粘贴后存不下来。现在会换成服务器写得了的名字保存，原来的名字留作标题；另一个引用它的粘贴画板也会跟着用新名字。右键菜单的 **Paste** 现在能读你复制的图片。浏览器不让读的时候，就粘贴编辑器自己的复制内容。

### 文档
- `claude-slides`、`claude-design`、`claude-design-system`、`claude-data` 的 `SKILL.md` 列出了会向 Agent 发请求的按钮，并说明请求怎么送到。`claude-whiteboard` 的写明了白板上的视频是用户放的，以及哪些功能仍然不能用。

releaseNotes.en:
### Features
- **`claude-design`: see a page at another screen width, and save the whole page at that width as a PNG.** Open an artboard full window (the toolbar's **Play**, then the artboard) and pick **Fill**: next to Fill/Fit is a width control. It follows the window, or lays the page out at Phone 390, Tablet 768, 1024, 1280, 1440 or 1920 px (and the artboard's own width when it is none of these), centred, and scaled down to fit when wider than the window, with the scale shown beside the width. Whenever that width is not the artboard's own, the artboard's **Export** offers **PNG 1×, this width** and **PNG 2×, this width**: the whole page laid out at that width, as tall as its content, saved as `<name>-<width>w@<scale>x.png`. `SKILL.md` tells the agent to point users there when they ask for a page at a screen width or a full-page screenshot (requested by @hh0592821, [#42](https://github.com/JimLiu/baoyu-design/issues/42)).
releaseNotes.zh:
### 新功能
- **`claude-design`：按别的屏幕宽度看页面，并把这个宽度下的整页存成 PNG。** 把画板全窗口打开（工具栏的 **Play**，再点画板），选 **Fill**：Fill / Fit 旁边多了一个宽度控件。可以跟随窗口，也可以按 Phone 390、Tablet 768、1024、1280、1440、1920 px 排版（画板自己的宽度不在其中时也列出来），页面居中；比窗口宽时按比例缩小放进窗口，宽度旁边写着比例。只要这个宽度不是画板自己的宽度，画板的 **Export** 里就有 **PNG 1×, this width** 和 **PNG 2×, this width**：按这个宽度排版的整页，高度跟内容走，存成 `<名字>-<宽度>w@<倍数>x.png`。`SKILL.md` 也写了：用户要看某个屏幕宽度下的页面、或要整页截图时，Agent 告诉他们在哪里操作（@hh0592821 提出，[#42](https://github.com/JimLiu/baoyu-design/issues/42)）。

releaseNotes.en:
### Fixes
- DeepSeek Harness: the **Artifacts** page showed one artifact to a row, each card as wide as the page. Since 2.14.1 a style meant for one card's drawing also applied to the whole list. The list is a grid of cards again.
- DeepSeek Harness: a plugin that was added from a folder and later uninstalled got no tile under **Make something new**, and the page could not install it. Its files stay in the profile after the uninstall, and the page took them for a plugin that is installed and switched off. The page now goes by what the app's plugin manager counts as installed, so the plugin gets its **Not installed** tile and installs from there.
releaseNotes.zh:
### 修复
- DeepSeek Harness：「作品」页每行只显示一个作品，卡片和页面一样宽。从 2.14.1 起，给某一种卡片的示意图写的样式也作用到了整个列表上。现在列表恢复成多列的卡片网格。
- DeepSeek Harness：从文件夹添加、后来又卸载的插件，在 **Make something new** 下没有磁贴，也没法从页面上安装。卸载后它的文件还留在 profile 里，页面把它当成了「装了但关掉」的插件。现在页面按应用的插件管理器认定的「已安装」来判断，这个插件会显示 **Not installed**（未安装）磁贴，可以从那里安装。

releaseNotes.en:
### Features
- **`claude-motion` follows claude.ai's 2026-11-10 update.** A film that has a `narration.js` but no voice track of its own gets a **Voiceover** section under Tweaks in the side panel and a voiceover lane under the timeline. Change a line and click **Record changes**: the edit reaches the agent as a request (`comments --wait` prints it under `requests`; with no agent listening, the text is there to copy). A film with a voice track of its own (`modules/voice.json`) keeps its **Script** tab and lanes. `write-db` now refuses to write the records the page keeps of what you set by hand (`modules/retyped.json`, `recolored.json`, `recut.json`, `refaced.json`, `retouched.json`, `fetched-fonts.json`) and says `PAGE_ONLY`.
- **`claude-design-system` follows claude.ai's 2026-11-10 update.** Edits are saved as soon as the page is hidden (you switch tabs, say) instead of waiting for the autosave. A toast you close hands the focus back to where it was, and F6 reaches it.
- **`claude-slides` follows claude.ai's 2026-11-10 update.** A slide that can't be read, or whose markup may be partly hidden, says so on the slide and in the inspector, with **Ask the agent to fix** (with no conversation listening it copies a prompt to paste). A selected SVG image can't be set to Cover or Hug, and the inspector says why: it would change when the presentation reopens. While presenting, a swipe that starts on the page-number strip no longer turns the slide. A `deck.json` with a `format` this version doesn't know opens read-only, with a banner that it was saved by a newer version of Slides, and is not rewritten. Tables are saved with a wrapper for each row and with table, row and cell roles, so columns line up and screen readers read them as tables.
- **Every editor draws Markdown in comments.** Markdown in a comment or an agent's reply (bold, code, lists, quotes and so on) is drawn, not shown as characters; the **All comments** list keeps each row to flat text. The new-comment card shows a focus ring while you type in it.
- **DeepSeek Harness: the Artifacts page's type tiles follow claude.ai's "Make something new" row.** Each type is a tile with a pastel wash and a chalk doodle (dark mode swaps wash and ink), with redrawn type icons and a Beta badge on Data, Whiteboard and Motion. Rest the pointer on a tile, or Tab to it, and a card shows the type's name, what it makes and whether it is installed, with a button to start one, install it, or see the install. Escape closes the card; touch skips it.

### Fixes
- `claude-slides`: its third-party licenses notice now carries the OfficeGen attribution that pptxgenjs's source header names.

### Documentation
- `claude-motion`'s `SKILL.md` and reference follow the same update. The agent ends with the film's url. A film for a loop, a GIF or a lobby screen has no score unless one is asked for. A request that says both what the film is for and how it should look skips the questions form. Plain films start from Inter and Space Grotesk. `by-hand.md` covers the page's records of lines retyped and colors set by hand.
releaseNotes.zh:
### 新功能
- **`claude-motion` 跟上了 claude.ai 2026-11-10 的更新。** 只有 `narration.js`、没有自己配音轨的影片，侧边栏 Tweaks 里多了 **Voiceover** 一节，时间轴下多了一条 voiceover 轨。改一行台词，点 **Record changes**，这处改动会作为一个请求发给 agent（`comments --wait` 在 `requests` 下打印它；没有 agent 在听时，给出文字让你复制）。有自己配音轨（`modules/voice.json`）的影片，保持原来的 **Script** 标签页和轨道。`write-db` 现在拒绝写页面自己记的手改记录（`modules/retyped.json`、`recolored.json`、`recut.json`、`refaced.json`、`retouched.json`、`fetched-fonts.json`），报 `PAGE_ONLY`。
- **`claude-design-system` 跟上了 claude.ai 2026-11-10 的更新。** 页面一被隐藏（比如切到别的标签页）就立刻保存，不再等自动保存。关掉 toast 后焦点回到原来的位置，F6 也能走到 toast。
- **`claude-slides` 跟上了 claude.ai 2026-11-10 的更新。** 读不出来的幻灯片，或标记可能被部分隐藏的幻灯片，会在幻灯片上和属性面板里说明，并带 **Ask the agent to fix**（没有对话在听时，复制一段提示词让你贴给 agent）。选中的 SVG 图片不能设成 Cover 或 Hug，属性面板会说明原因：重新打开演示稿时它会变样。放映时从页码条上开始的滑动不再翻页。`deck.json` 带着这个版本不认识的 `format` 时，只读打开，顶上提示它由更新版本的 Slides 保存，文件不会被改写。表格按行包一层，并带 table、row、cell 的 role，列对得齐，读屏软件也按表格来读。
- **所有编辑器的评论按 Markdown 显示。** 评论或 agent 回复里的 Markdown（粗体、代码、列表、引用等）直接画出来，不再显示成原样字符；**All comments** 列表里每一行仍是平铺的文字。新评论卡在你输入时有焦点环。
- **DeepSeek Harness：「作品」页的类型磁贴跟 claude.ai 的「Make something new」一行一致。** 每个类型一块磁贴：淡色底加粉笔涂鸦（深色模式下底色和线条互换），类型图标重画，Data、Whiteboard、Motion 带 Beta 角标。鼠标停在磁贴上，或者用 Tab 走到它，会出现一张卡片，写着类型名、它做什么、装没装，以及开始新建、安装或查看安装的按钮。Esc 关闭卡片，触屏不出卡片。

### 修复
- `claude-slides`：第三方许可说明补上了 pptxgenjs 源码文件头写明的 OfficeGen 署名。

### 文档
- `claude-motion` 的 `SKILL.md` 和 reference 也跟着这次更新。agent 收尾时给出影片的地址。循环播放、GIF、展厅屏幕这类影片，不要求配乐就不配。请求里既说了影片干什么用、又说了要什么样子，就不再弹问题表单。普通的影片从 Inter 和 Space Grotesk 起手。`by-hand.md` 讲了页面记录的手改台词和手改颜色。

releaseNotes.en:
### Features
- **DeepSeek Harness: open your work from another device.** When Harness runs on one computer and you use it from another (`dsh web` on a server, opened in a browser on your laptop or phone over the same network or a tailnet), opening an item from **Artifacts**, or **View thread** on a comment card, gave a `http://127.0.0.1:…` link that only that computer can open. The plugin now gives the device you are on a link of its own, at the address your browser reaches Harness by, and opens it in a new tab. Through it you are the editor's owner, as on that computer: you edit, and **Send to Agent** is there. Behind a proxy or a domain of your own, set `BAOYU_DESIGN_REMOTE_HOST` to the address other devices reach that computer at; `off` turns this off. Every editor's `open` takes `--remote[=<host>]` to print that owner's link (`--remote=off` closes it), and `share <folder> --reset owner` replaces its key. See [Use it from another device](https://github.com/JimLiu/baoyu-design/blob/main/dsh-plugins/README.md#use-it-from-another-device) (requested by @akaDeyve, [#40](https://github.com/JimLiu/baoyu-design/issues/40)).
- **DeepSeek Harness: `dsh-claude-dashboard` updates to `dsh-claude-data`.** The Artifacts page names the type **Data**, and offers an installed `dsh-claude-dashboard` as an update, `claude-dashboard → claude-data`: **Update** installs `dsh-claude-data`, switched on or off as the old one was, then uninstalls `dsh-claude-dashboard`. A preset that names `dsh-claude-dashboard` keeps it, and the page says what to change. 2.14.0 said `dsh-claude-dashboard` would get no more updates; instead it keeps getting releases with no skill in them. An Artifacts page from 2.13.0 or earlier offers that release as an update, and it brings the page that offers the move, so click **Update** once more when the move shows.

### Fixes
- `claude-design-system`: a guest on a **Share** link could not add an asset or a font. The page stayed at **Adding …**, because a page served over plain http on the network lacks the browser's hashing that the upload used. It now hashes the file itself.
- DeepSeek Harness: uninstalling the plugin that was running the Artifacts page left the page at a 404 until the app restarted. Another installed plugin now takes it over at once.
releaseNotes.zh:
### 新功能
- **DeepSeek Harness：在另一台设备上打开你的作品。** Harness 跑在一台电脑上、你在另一台设备上用时（比如服务器上跑 `dsh web`，在笔记本或手机的浏览器里通过同一个局域网或 tailnet 打开），从 **Artifacts**（「作品」）打开，或者点评论卡片上的 **View thread**，拿到的是 `http://127.0.0.1:…`，只有那台电脑打得开。现在插件会给你手上这台设备一个它自己的链接，地址就是浏览器访问 Harness 用的那个，在新标签页里打开。通过它打开，你就是编辑器的主人，和在那台电脑上一样：能编辑，也有 **Send to Agent**。经过代理或用自己的域名访问时，把 `BAOYU_DESIGN_REMOTE_HOST` 设成其他设备访问那台电脑用的地址；设成 `off` 就关掉这个功能。每个编辑器的 `open` 都可以加 `--remote[=<host>]`，打出这个主人链接（`--remote=off` 关掉），`share <文件夹> --reset owner` 换一把钥匙。见[在另一台设备上用](https://github.com/JimLiu/baoyu-design/blob/main/dsh-plugins/README.zh-CN.md#在另一台设备上用)（@akaDeyve 提出，[#40](https://github.com/JimLiu/baoyu-design/issues/40)）。
- **DeepSeek Harness：`dsh-claude-dashboard` 可以更新成 `dsh-claude-data`。** 「作品」页上这个类型叫 **数据**（Data），装着 `dsh-claude-dashboard` 的，会把换到新插件当作一项更新来提示，写作 `claude-dashboard → claude-data`：点 **Update**（更新）会先装上 `dsh-claude-data`（开关和旧插件一样），再卸载 `dsh-claude-dashboard`。预设里写了 `dsh-claude-dashboard` 的，旧插件会留着，页面上会说要改哪里。2.14.0 说 `dsh-claude-dashboard` 不再更新；现在改成它继续发不带技能的版本。2.13.0 或更早的「作品」页会把这个版本当作更新来提示，装上它就有了会提示换插件的新「作品」页，提示出来后再点一次 **Update**。

### 修复
- `claude-design-system`：通过 **Share**（分享）链接进来的访客加不了资源和字体，页面一直停在 **Adding …**。局域网上用明文 http 打开的页面没有浏览器自带的哈希功能，上传要用它。现在由页面自己算。
- DeepSeek Harness：卸载正在提供「作品」页的那个插件后，这个页面一直是 404，要重启应用才好。现在另一个装着的插件会马上接手。

releaseNotes.en:
### Features
- **`claude-dashboard` is now `claude-data`.** claude.ai renamed the type to Data, and the skill, its DeepSeek Harness plugin (`dsh-claude-data`) and its ChatGPT and Codex plugin (**Baoyu Data**) follow. Call it as `/claude-data` (`$claude-data` in Codex). A dashboard made with `claude-dashboard` opens in `claude-data` as it is, with the same folder; its address is now `/data/<id>/` instead of `/dashboard/<id>/`. `dsh-claude-dashboard` and **Baoyu Dashboard** get no more updates: install `dsh-claude-data` (the **Artifacts** page offers it as a **Not installed** tile) or **Baoyu Data**, then remove the old one. On the Artifacts page, dashboards opened before the rename are listed with the new kind and still open, and comments sent from a dashboard reach the agent through `dsh-claude-data` (the copy of `dsh-claude-data` put on npm on its own before this release lacked both, because the Host plugin it came with did not know the new name).
- **`claude-data` follows claude.ai's 2026-11-10 update.** A dashboard's toolbar now has a **Design** button. It shows the look in use and a new **Style** section: chart colors, page color, font, corners and text size. A change shows on the page at once and is kept with **Save**; **Reset all** goes back to the defaults. A dataset can be a text file (`format: "text"`), which the page turns into rows with a loader. `dash/meta` takes the page's language (`lang`). `check` also reports what the open page found when it checked itself (`pageCheck`: passed, failed with what went wrong, or still loading) beside the page's `runs`.
- **`claude-design` follows claude.ai's 2026-11-10 update.** Pen, Line and Arrow have a **Drawing options** bar: four stroke weights, and solid, dashed or dotted lines. An artboard's export menu has **All artboards (.png)**, a zip with one PNG per artboard on the page. When the canvas's saved layout is damaged, the canvas turns read-only with a banner and an **Ask the agent to fix** button, and comes back on its own once the file is fixed. A new reference, `shaders.md`, is how the agent makes a shader artboard (WebGL, or anything that moves like light, water, smoke or liquid).

### Fixes
- `claude-design`: artboards ran React's development build (1.1 MB), which printed warnings such as `Invalid DOM property vector-effect` for drawn lines. They now run the production build (354 KB).
- `claude-design`: when two tabs changed the same artboard and you chose **Keep both**, the copy was put 80 px right of the original, where it could cover another artboard. It now goes in the first free spot right of that row.
- In every editor, Escape pressed while the keyboard is in the comments layer (on the comments button, say) now ends comment mode, as it does on the page.

### Documentation
- `claude-data`'s `SKILL.md` and reference follow the same update: what runs where (each reader's browser loads the datasets, and Sources shows where every number came from), what a page's code may write and when, and how `check` and `runs` report a page that went wrong.
releaseNotes.zh:
### 新功能
- **`claude-dashboard` 改名为 `claude-data`。** claude.ai 把这个类型改名为 Data，技能、它的 DeepSeek Harness 插件（`dsh-claude-data`）和 ChatGPT、Codex 插件（**Baoyu Data**）都跟着改名。调用名是 `/claude-data`（Codex 里是 `$claude-data`）。用 `claude-dashboard` 做的仪表盘，原样用 `claude-data` 打开，文件夹不变；地址从 `/dashboard/<id>/` 变成 `/data/<id>/`。`dsh-claude-dashboard` 和 **Baoyu Dashboard** 不再更新：装上 `dsh-claude-data`（**Artifacts** 页面上它是一个 **Not installed** 的卡片，点开就能装）或 **Baoyu Data**，再把旧的删掉。改名前打开过的仪表盘，在 Artifacts 页面上按新的类型列出，照样能打开；仪表盘上发出的评论经 `dsh-claude-data` 交给 Agent（这一版之前单独发到 npm 的 `dsh-claude-data` 这两样都不行，因为和它配套的 Host 插件还不认识新名字）。
- **`claude-data` 跟上了 claude.ai 2026-11-10 的更新。** 仪表盘的工具栏多了一个 **Design** 按钮，里面是当前的外观和新的 **Style** 一段：图表配色、页面底色、字体、圆角和字号。改了页面马上显示，点 **Save** 保存；**Reset all** 回到默认。数据集可以是文本文件（`format: "text"`），由页面用 loader 拆成行。`dash/meta` 可以写页面的语言（`lang`）。`check` 还会报告打开着的页面自查的结果（`pageCheck`：通过、没通过和出了什么问题、还在加载），和页面的 `runs` 放在一起。
- **`claude-design` 跟上了 claude.ai 2026-11-10 的更新。** 画笔、直线和箭头有了 **Drawing options** 条：四档粗细，实线、虚线或点线。画板的导出菜单里多了 **All artboards (.png)**，把这一页每块画板各导出一张 PNG，打成一个 zip。画布保存的布局文件坏了时，画布变成只读，顶上有横幅和 **Ask the agent to fix** 按钮，文件修好后自己恢复。新增 reference `shaders.md`，Agent 照它做着色器画板（WebGL，或者像光、水、烟、液体那样流动的效果）。

### 修复
- `claude-design`：画板里跑的是 React 的开发版（1.1 MB），画的线会报 `Invalid DOM property vector-effect` 这类警告。现在是生产版（354 KB）。
- `claude-design`：两个标签页改了同一块画板、选 **Keep both** 时，副本放在原画板右边 80 px，可能压住那里的另一块画板。现在放在这一行右边第一个空位。
- 所有编辑器：键盘在评论层里时（比如停在评论按钮上）按 Escape，现在会退出评论模式，和在页面上按一样。

### 文档
- `claude-data` 的 `SKILL.md` 和 reference 也跟着这次更新：什么在哪里运行（每个读者的浏览器加载数据集，Sources 说明每个数字从哪里来），页面的代码什么时候可以写入、能写什么，以及 `check` 和 `runs` 怎样报告出错的页面。

releaseNotes.en:
### Features
- **Whiteboard is released.** `claude-whiteboard` lays out thinking on a board: a diagram, a flow, a map of ideas, a plan, a comparison or a drawn explanation. The agent writes it as elements (sections, blocks joined by arrows, text, tables, sticky notes, drawings and small working embeds) into the board's own store, and you watch them land in the local board editor. There you move and resize things, type, draw with the pen, and add sections, sticky notes, shapes and stickers from the toolbar, and the agent sees what you changed. Comment on an item, a spot or an area and send it to the agent, which changes the board and replies. **Share** opens the board to your local network with a link per role, everyone on a link sees the others' cursors and changes live, and its Export tab downloads the whole folder as a zip. **History** lists the versions. One server serves every board on the computer. Needs Node 22+. The board's own assistant on claude.ai (the Ask box, cursor chat, read-aloud and dictation) is not available locally; ask the agent in your conversation instead.
- DeepSeek Harness: the new `dsh-claude-whiteboard` plugin. Comments sent from a board reach the agent, and boards are listed on the **Artifacts** page with a picture of the board, where they can be renamed like the other kinds.
- ChatGPT and Codex: the new **Baoyu Whiteboard** plugin in the baoyu-design marketplace.
releaseNotes.zh:
### 新功能
- **白板正式发布。** `claude-whiteboard` 把想法摆在白板上：示意图、流程、想法地图、计划、对比或手绘的讲解。Agent 把它写成一个个元素（分区、用箭头连起来的方块、文字、表格、便签、手绘图和能操作的小嵌入），存进白板自己的存储，你在本地白板编辑器里看着它们一个个出现。你可以拖动、缩放、打字、用画笔画，从工具栏加分区、便签、形状和贴纸，你改了什么 Agent 也看得到。对一个元素、一个位置或一块区域留评论发给 Agent，它改好白板再回复你。**Share** 把白板开放到局域网，每种角色一个链接，拿到链接的人能实时看到彼此的光标和改动，它的 Export 页可以把整个文件夹下载成 zip。**History** 列出各个版本。这台电脑上的所有白板共用一个服务器。需要 Node 22+。claude.ai 上白板自带的助手（Ask 输入框、光标聊天、朗读和听写）在本地用不了，在对话里问 Agent 就好。
- DeepSeek Harness：新增 `dsh-claude-whiteboard` 插件。白板上发出的评论会交给 Agent，白板也列在 **Artifacts** 页面上，带白板的缩略图，可以像其他类型一样改名。
- ChatGPT 和 Codex：baoyu-design 插件市场新增 **Baoyu Whiteboard** 插件。

releaseNotes.en:
### Fixes
- **`claude-design`: `check` now catches a canvas title placed too close above its row.** An artboard's name strip keeps its size on screen while a title (`title1`) scales with the canvas, so a title 140 px above its row looked fine at 100% but covered the artboards' names once zoomed out below about 50%. `SKILL.md` already asked for at least 223 px. `check` now reports a title of 72 px or more that is closer than that to the artboards under it, or that sits over one: one issue per title, with the `y` to move it to. Text the user adds with the editor's text tool is left alone, wherever it is (contributed by @congee949, [#38](https://github.com/JimLiu/baoyu-design/pull/38)).
releaseNotes.zh:
### 修复
- **`claude-design`：`check` 现在会查出离画板太近的画布标题。** 画板的名称条在屏幕上大小不变，标题（`title1`）却跟着画布缩放，所以标题放在一行画板上方 140 px，100% 时看着没问题，缩到 50% 以下就压住了画板的名字。`SKILL.md` 本来就要求至少 223 px；现在 72 px 及以上的标题离下面的画板不到这个距离，或者压在画板上，`check` 都会报出来，每个标题一条，并给出要挪到的 `y`。用户用编辑器文字工具加的文字，放在哪里都不查（@congee949 贡献，[#38](https://github.com/JimLiu/baoyu-design/pull/38)）。
