evidence.readmeExcerpt: # MOKI Library for DSH English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) ![MOKI Library — file management, rich previews and AI editing in DeepSeek Harness](docs/media/cover.png) **Give DSH a file explorer. Keep AI-generated work organized.** MOKI Library is a community plugin for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**. It brings a local file library, multi-format previews and Office editing into the same workspace as your DSH conversations. Move from finding a file to reading, selecting, editing and saving it in one workflow. Organize a project, then keep its documents and spreadsheets beside the conversation. [Five usage demos](docs/usage-demos.md) · [Create PPTs in the side workspace](docs/ppt-side-workspace.md) · [Preview and editing format support](docs/formats.md) · [Media kit](docs/social/README.md) [Copy a prompt to install with DSH](#install-with-dsh) · [Download](https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-library-for-dsh/releases/latest) · [Usage guide (中文)](docs/guide.zh-CN.md) · [Features](docs/features.md) · [Report an issue](https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-library-for-dsh/issues) ## Interface and navigation Open **Library settings → Interface language** to choose **Follow DSH** (default), **简体中文** or **English**. The choice is saved across restarts and updates open library views immediately, independently of DSH’s own interface language. File names, paths, tags and document contents are preserved. An already-open Office editor keeps its current language until reopened, so unsaved edits are not interrupted. Start a selection drag in the blank space on either side of the library, or between cards and rows. Name, modified-time and added-time sorting compare all items together, without grouping folders or file formats first. Missing dates appear last. ## What you can do - **Manage files, folders and links.** Map existing local files, organize virtual folders and tags, search, and switch between list and card views. An empty folder welcomes drag-and-drop imports. - **Preview without switching apps.** Images, audio/video, PDF, Office, text, archives, fonts and common 3D formats have built-in preview paths. Some formats require conversion or have documented limitations. - **Edit Word, Excel and PowerPoint.** Work on isolated drafts, see changes in the editor, then save back or save a copy. - **Collaborate on a precise selection.** Pass text offsets, sheet/range addresses, slide objects, page numbers or a selected image region to DSH. Use **Alt+D** to open the conversation while viewing a document. - **Choose your workspace.** Use the main library, side-workspace tabs, movable native preview windows, or your system's default app. The floating conversation supports the native DSH input capabilities. - **Connect files to conversations.** Optionally add a library attachment picker above the composer and automatically map newly created DSH task files. - **Keep context compact.** Selection references carry bounded content and exact locations. Supported edits use `context → edit_selection`; complex edits can use the Office tools. ![Full DSH interface with MOKI Library beside the conversation and two selected files referenced in the composer](docs/media/dsh-workspace.png) **Library and conversation in one window.** In this actual local DSH Web capture, “项目排期.xlsx” and “产品介绍.docx” are selected in the side workspace. **Add selection to conversation** places a native reference in the composer, followed by the user's request. The files are demonstration data and the input is an unsent draft. [Card-view alternative](docs/media/dsh-workspace-cards.png). ![Library in list and card views, using public demonstration files](docs/media/library.png) ![Excel selection and DSH floating chat, composed from public demonstration UI captures](docs/media/editing.png) The collaboration illustration includes the DSH floating composer with a `Sheet1!C2:C6` reference and an unsent request. [Original floating-chat capture](docs/media/raw/dsh-floating-chat.png). ## Install Tested on **Windows with DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1**. Declared compatibility: `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0`; other desktop versions and operating systems need further verification. The plugin requires **Node.js 22.19+**. Native preview windows use a locally installed Edge or Chrome. FFmpeg is optional for additional audio/video decoding. ### Option 1: Copy this prompt into DSH 1. Open **DSH Desktop → New conversation**, select an available model, and make sure the conversation can run local terminal commands. 2. Use the copy button at the top right of the following block. **Paste the entire prompt into the DSH conversation composer and send it.** This is an agent task; terminal commands are provided in the manual installation option below. ```text Please install the MOKI Library plugin in my current DSH Desktop, including the download, installation and version verification. Repository: https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-library-for-dsh Version: 0.1.70 Package: https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-library-for-dsh/releases/download/v0.1.70/dsh-moki-library-0.1.70.tgz SHA256 checksum manifest: https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-library-for-dsh/releases/download/v0.1.70/SHA256SUMS.txt Follow these steps: 1. Check the operating system, DSH version and the Node.js runtime it uses. The plugin requires DSH >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0 and Node.js >=22.19. Windows Desktop is the primary verified environment. 2. Locate the CLI belonging to this desktop installation. On Windows, prefer resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh.cmd inside its installation directory. Use the desktop's existing DSH_HOME if one is set. Target the desktop profile. 3. Check the installed dsh-moki-library version in desktop. Verify an existing identical version; retain and report a newer version. If installation is needed, download the .tgz above locally and verify its SHA256. 4. Use the actual CLI and the downloaded archive's absolute path with this command pattern. Replace with that path, using forward slashes on Windows: dsh plugin --profile desktop add "dsh-moki-library@file:" --allow-build=sharp 5. Check the installed version: dsh plugin --profile desktop list dsh-moki-library --depth 0 Confirm that desktop lists version 0.1.70 (or the newer version retained above). Preserve existing plugins, configuration and library data. 6. Report the archive location, actual CLI, profile and version-check result. Then ask me to save my work, fully quit DSH and reopen it manually. Keep the current DSH conversation running while the installation task is in progress. If this conversation cannot download files or execute a terminal, the environment is incompatible, or installation fails, explain the specific cause and next step. Report installation status from the actual command results. ``` 3. Respond to DSH's prompts for the download or terminal operation, if shown, and wait for its installation and version-check results. 4. Save your work, **fully quit DSH and reopen it**. Confirm that **MOKI Library** is enabled in the plugin list, then open it from the sidebar. 5. Preview a sample file. In a supported editor, select text or cells and press **Alt+D** to check the conversation entry. Enable the library attachment picker or task-file mapping in library settings if needed. ### Option 2: Install manually in a terminal 1. Open DSH Desktop once to initialize its desktop profile, then fully quit it. Download `dsh-moki-library-0.1.70.tgz` from the [release](https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-library-for-dsh/releases/tag/v0.1.70). 2. In PowerShell, replace the first two paths with the actual CLI and archive paths. If the desktop uses a custom `DSH_HOME`, use the same value in this terminal. ```powershell $mokiDshCli = 'C:\Path\To\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' $mokiArchive = 'C:\Downloads\dsh-moki-library-0.1.70.tgz' $mokiArchive = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $mokiArchive).Path.Replace('\', '/') & $mokiDshCli plugin --profile desktop add "dsh-moki-library@file:$mokiArchive" --allow-build=sharp ``` 3. After the install command succeeds, check the version, then reopen DSH: ```powershell & $mokiDshCli plugin --profile desktop list dsh-moki-library --depth 0 ``` If `dsh` is on PATH and belongs to the current desktop installation, use it in place of `& $mokiDshCli`. `--profile desktop` targets the desktop profile; `--allow-build=sharp` allows the installation build step for the `sharp` image dependency. Initial installation requires network access for runtime dependencies. See the [official DSH CLI reference](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/cli-help.md#dsh-plugin) for profile command syntax. The GitHub source archive is for development; the `.tgz` release asset is the built plugin. This release does not require an npm publication. ## Selection collaboration ### Your first workflow 1. Open **MOKI Library** from DSH's sidebar. Use **Add files** or drag files, folders and links into the content area. 2. Organize virtual folders and tags. Search by name, tag or path, clear the search with one click, and switch between list/card views. Hover over a thumbnail for a larger preview. 3. Open a file. By default, the main library uses separate preview windows and the side workspace opens new tabs. Settings can explicitly choose DSH's main window, a separate window or the default app. 4. Select text in preview or edit mode and click the **whale beside the selection**. A compact input opens beside the selection with its content and location already attached. Type an instruction, optionally choose, drop or paste files, then press **Send** (Enter; Shift+Enter for a new line). **After sending, the side workspace focuses the current main conversation; main-window and standalone previews open a floating DSH conversation.** **Alt+D** and **Add selection to conversation** remain available. The whale also appears at Word/PPT text insertion positions, empty Excel cells and text-editor carets. Clicking an empty PDF page area quotes its page and page-relative position. Empty positions never reuse previously selected text. 5. Review the highlighted AI edits, then choose **Accept** or **Discard edit**. **Accept saves to the original file immediately**, keeping the editor open at the current position. Continue editing or reopen the file to check persistence. Text previews, PDF text, the text editor and Office editors support quick selection chat, including file and precise location references. Mouse and keyboard selection work in side workspace tabs and separate preview windows. Opening the quick input never sends a message. Its Send button submits only the captured selection, your instruction and its attachments; existing DSH draft text and attachments stay intact. Failed sends retain the quick input for retry. Files use DSH’s native attachment pipeline (32 MB per file). Use visual region selection for scanned PDFs; selections in the default external application remain managed by that application. ### Review before saving AI edits to text, Word, Excel and PowerPoint are highlighted. Expand the review bar to see locations and before/after content. Highlights are temporary decorations, never saved document formatting. **Accept saves the current result to the original file without reloading or leaving the editor.** The current slide, sheet, selection and view stay in place. If saving fails, the pending edits remain available for retry. The Office editor stays loaded while AI work is in progress. Progress updates and read-only tool calls preserve the current selection instead of reopening the editor. Incoming changes appear in the existing view; actual pending edits still require review. You can ask DSH to continue editing before accepting an earlier edit. Each new edit builds on the visible draft and adds a review record. Choose **Accept all**, or **Undo latest edit** repeatedly to step back while retaining earlier pending edits. Selection, copying and AI collaboration remain available; manual input and saving wait until review is resolved. Pending records recover with the draft. If another window changes that draft, cancellation reports the conflict and preserves the current content. ### Practical examples | Task | Select first | Example prompt and check | | --- | --- | --- | | Excel schedule | `C2:C6` on the intended sheet | “Increase each selected planned-day value by 1; preserve other cells and styles.” Inspect, save and reopen | | Word / text revision | A passage | “Make this more concise, preserving facts and proper names. Change only the selected range.” Check context and styles | | PowerPoint heading | Highlighted text inside the intended text box | “Replace with ‘Review before saving’; preserve the box position and font size.” Check wrapping and layout | | PDF reading | Text on the relevant page | “Explain this passage, identify its page and list conditions I should verify.” Read-only analysis | | Image / scanned page | A selected region | “Describe this region and explicitly mark unreadable text.” Requires a vision-capable model | ![Image-region and PDF previews](docs/media/previews.png) The [illustrated usage demos](docs/usage-demos.md) include exact steps, sample prompts, expected checks and window/workspace choices. Sample prompts are instructions, not fabricated AI transcripts. ### Selections, attachments and task files **Add selection to conversation** carries selected content and its location. **Library → Add attachments** supplies selected files, after enabling the library composer button in settings. Separately, **automatic task-file mapping** collects newly created/delivered DSH files in “DSH task files” after it is enabled, deduplicating identical paths. The whale opens the same compact selection input as MOKI Canvas. After sending in the side workspace, the current main conversation receives focus so the file stays beside the chat. The DSH conversation button and Alt+D still open the conversation directly. Main-window and standalone previews use a floating conversation with DSH's native input, moving/resizing and session creation/switching. A standalone preview keeps its conversation inside that window. Moving back to the side workspace routes quotes to the current main session instead of a previously selected floating history session. Default context text is bounded to 4,000 characters; composer quotes to 1,000. Truncation is marked. Tools can request more content when needed. Selection references are scoped to the conversation/editor, expire after ten minutes, and reject stale or reused edits. ### HTML selections, folder colors and generated files Select text in a rendered HTML preview and click the whale to enter instructions with optional attachments. The selection is mapped to exact source text nodes, so repeated text elsewhere is preserved. Inline markup stays intact; replacements are escaped as text. HTML scripts remain disabled. AI edits are highlighted for review; accepting saves without reloading the preview or resetting its scroll position. Switch to source view for structural or style edits. Enable **Select modules** in an HTML preview to identify page modules under the pointer. Hover shows a boundary; clicking keeps the module highlighted and reveals the whale for quick instructions. The reference includes the module's text, element location and a bounded HTML excerpt. **Alt+↑** expands to the parent module and **Esc** clears the selection. Scrolling keeps highlights aligned. Links are selected without navigating in this mode; turning it off restores normal text selection. New folders offer six colors (violet, blue, green, amber, rose and slate) with matching light and dark palettes. The choice persists and can also be changed from the folder context menu. DSH generated-file cards and change review pages offer a **Library** button; file context menus include **Open in MOKI Library**. The original file is mapped under **DSH task files** once, independently of the automatic-mapping setting. Existing mappings are reused. Preview preferences determine the destination; automatic mode opens a new side tab when the library is already docked. Explicitly choosing the library overrides a system-app default and opens the library's main window. To choose where to file an output, right-click it and select **Add to MOKI Library**. Browse or search library folders, or create a named folder with a color, then choose **Add to this folder**. Root and mapped folders are supported. This adds a reference to the original file, without moving or copying it. Repeated additions to the same folder reuse its reference; references in other folders remain intact. This action works even when automatic mapping and the composer picker are disabled. ## Preview and editing formats | Category | Main formats | Preview | In-plugin editing | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Word / Excel / PowerPoint | DOCX, XLSX, PPTX | Supported | Supported; review the draft before saving | | Delimited data / workspace | CSV, TSV, UNIVER | Supported | Supported; CSV/TSV do not retain workbook styling | | Text and code | TXT, MD, JSON, HTML, XML, YAML, JS/TS, Python and more | Supported | Listed editable extensions up to 5 MB | | Legacy / Apple Office | DOC, PPT, PAGES, NUMBERS, KEY | Limited content extraction | No; convert to an editable format first | | Images / design files | PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG, BMP, AVIF, ICO, PSD/PSB, TGA, TIFF | Image or composite preview | No image/layer editor | | PDF / OFD / AI | PDF, OFD, PDF-compatible AI | Page, text or region | Reading/analysis, not source-format editing | | Audio / video | MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI, WebM; MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG and more | Codec-dependent, optional FFmpeg | No media editing workflow | | 3D / fonts | GLB, glTF, OBJ, STL, PLY, FBX; TTF, OTF, WOFF, WOFF2 | Model controls / font samples | No model/font source editing | | Archives | ZIP/ZIP64, RAR5, 7z, TAR, GZ, BZ2, XZ, CAB and more | Read-only directory/search/paging | No archive-content editing | HEIC/HEIF depend on decoder availability. Legacy XLS, macro-enabled and password-protected documents are not listed as supported embedded editing formats. See the [full matrix](docs/formats.md) for extensions, sidecar resources, read-only formats and size limits. **Preview support does not imply editing support or complete fidelity for every file variant.** ## Data and limits The catalog, generated files and editing drafts are stored locally under `DSH_HOME/moki-library` or the user's `.dsh/moki-library` directory. Mapping an existing file keeps its original path. **Content selected for AI collaboration or attached to a conversation is provided to DSH and its configured model/tools.** Local storage is not a promise of offline AI processing. There is no single size cap for mapped files or streamed original-file previews. Decoder support, available memory and disk space still apply. Conversation attachments have a separate **32 MB** limit. Text over **5 MB** uses read-only paging. Whole-file decoding for selected preview types uses a **512 MiB** guard; Office structured-data previews use a **256 MiB** expanded-data budget. See the [format and size details](docs/guide.zh-CN.md#文件预览与大小). ## Build and test ```sh npm ci npm run build npm test node scripts/collect-licenses.mjs npm pack ``` The browser/Office tests use an installed Chrome or Edge. Tests create synthetic temporary files, never the user's library. Tests run serially to avoid competing Office runtimes. `src/` contains the DSH integration, `web/` the embedded UI, and `vendor/moki/` the required MOKI library modules. ## Open source and community - **MIT** for MOKI's source and the included MOKI modules. Dependencies retain their own licenses; see [third-party notices](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). - [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Public-release hygiene](docs/public-release.md) · [Media kit](docs/social/README.md). - Discover DSH extensions through the official [`dsh-plugin` topic](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) and [DeepSeek Harness Discussions](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions). - Join the [MOKI Library community discussion](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/12941) in **Show Your Plugins!**. Developed by **JKZeng / MOKI**. Contact: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/JKZeng-cell/moki-library-for-dsh/issues). This is an independent community plugin, not an official DeepSeek product. The DeepSeek Harness logo identifies the host application and belongs to its respective owner.

The fixed tree lacks lib/host.mjs and lib/client.js; downloadable TGZ/checksum declarations do not by themselves establish source-to-generated-runtime or native Office helper correspondence. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

# Superpowers

Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them.

This repository is the **Karpotkin Coding Harness** distribution: a clean-history,
cross-agent build maintained at `karpotkin/coding-harness`. It keeps the proven
Superpowers methodology and adds a native DeepSeek Harness adapter. See
[NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) for provenance.

## Table of Contents

- [How it works](#how-it-works)
- [Commercial Services](#commercial-services)
- [Getting Started](#installation)
  - [Claude Code](#claude-code)
  - [Antigravity](#antigravity)
  - [Codex App](#codex-app)
  - [Codex CLI](#codex-cli)
  - [Cursor](#cursor)
  - [DeepSeek Harness](#deepseek-harness)
  - [Devin CLI](#devin-cli)
  - [Factory Droid](#factory-droid)
  - [Gemini CLI](#gemini-cli)
  - [GitHub Copilot CLI](#github-copilot-cli)
  - [Grok Build CLI](#grok-build-cli)
  - [Kimi Code](#kimi-code)
  - [OpenCode](#opencode)
  - [Pi](#pi)
  - [Qwen Code](#qwen-code)
  - [Hermes Agent](#hermes-agent)
  - [Muse](#muse)
- [The Basic Workflow](#the-basic-workflow)
- [When Something Goes Wrong](#when-something-goes-wrong)
- [Community](#community)
- [What's Inside](#whats-inside)
- [Philosophy](#philosophy)
- [Contributing](#contributing)
- [Updating](#updating)
- [License](#license)
- [Visual companion telemetry](#visual-companion-telemetry)

## How it works

It starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent. As soon as it sees that you're building something, it *doesn't* just jump into trying to write code. Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do.

Once it's teased a spec out of the conversation, it shows it to you in chunks short enough to actually read and digest.

After you've signed off on the design, your agent puts together an implementation plan that's clear enough for an enthusiastic junior engineer with poor taste, no judgement, no project context, and an aversion to testing to follow. It emphasizes true red/green TDD, YAGNI (You Aren't Gonna Need It), and DRY.

Next up, once you say "go", it launches a *subagent-driven-development* process, having agents work through each engineering task, inspecting and reviewing their work, and continuing forward. It's not uncommon for your agent to work autonomously for a couple hours at a time without deviating from the plan you put together.

There's a bunch more to it, but that's the core of the system. And because the skills trigger automatically, you don't need to do anything special. Your coding agent just has Superpowers.

## Commercial Services

If you're using Superpowers in enterprise and could benefit from commercial support, additional tooling, or managed spending, please don't hesitate to drop us a line at sales@primeradiant.com.

## Installation

Installation differs by harness. If you use more than one, install Superpowers separately for each one.

### Claude Code

Superpowers is available via the [official Claude plugin marketplace](https://claude.com/plugins/superpowers)

#### Karpotkin Coding Harness

- Register this repository as a marketplace:

  ```bash
  /plugin marketplace add karpotkin/coding-harness
  ```

- Install the plugin:

  ```bash
  /plugin install superpowers@karpotkin-coding-harness
  ```

### Antigravity

Install Superpowers as a plugin from this repository:

```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/karpotkin/coding-harness
```

Antigravity lists each installed skill's description, and the description of
the `using-superpowers` skill prompts the model to load that skill at the start
of a conversation. Reinstall with the same command to update.

### Codex App

Superpowers is available via the [official Codex plugin marketplace](https://github.com/openai/plugins).

- In the Codex app, click on Plugins in the sidebar.
- You should see `Superpowers` in the Coding section.
- Click the `+` next to Superpowers and follow the prompts.

### Codex CLI

Register this repository and install its plugin:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add karpotkin/coding-harness
codex plugin add superpowers@karpotkin-coding-harness
```

### Cursor

- In Cursor Agent chat, install from marketplace:

  ```text
  /add-plugin superpowers
  ```

- Or search for "superpowers" in the plugin marketplace.

### DeepSeek Harness

Install into the profile you run (`web`, `headless`, or a custom profile):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:karpotkin/coding-harness
```

The adapter registers the shared skills through DeepSeek Harness's native skill
registry and injects the startup methodology into every session. Update it with:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web update superpowers
```

See [the DeepSeek Harness guide](docs/README.dsh.md) for details.

### Devin CLI

- Install the plugin from this repository:

  ```bash
  devin plugins install karpotkin/coding-harness
  ```

- Update to the latest version with:

  ```bash
  devin plugins update superpowers
  ```

### Factory Droid

- Register the marketplace:

  ```bash
  droid plugin marketplace add https://github.com/karpotkin/coding-harness
  ```

- Install the plugin:

  ```bash
  droid plugin install superpowers@superpowers
  ```

### Gemini CLI

- Install the extension:

  ```bash
  gemini extensions install https://github.com/karpotkin/coding-harness
  ```

- Update later:

  ```bash
  gemini extensions update superpowers
  ```

### GitHub Copilot CLI

- Register the marketplace:

  ```bash
  copilot plugin marketplace add karpotkin/coding-harness
  ```

- Install the plugin:

  ```bash
  copilot plugin install superpowers@karpotkin-coding-harness
  ```

### Grok Build CLI

Superpowers is available via the [official Grok plugin marketplace](https://github.com/xai-org/plugin-marketplace).

- Install the plugin from xAI's official marketplace:

  ```bash
  grok plugin install superpowers@xai-official --trust
  ```

- Or open the marketplace in the TUI, search for Superpowers, and install it:

  ```text
  /marketplace
  ```

### Kimi Code

Superpowers is available in Kimi Code's plugin marketplace.

- Open Kimi Code's plugin manager:

  ```text
  /plugins
  ```

- Go to `Marketplace` > `Superpowers` and install it.

- Or install directly from this repository:

  ```text
  /plugins install https://github.com/karpotkin/coding-harness
  ```

- Detailed docs: [docs/README.kimi.md](docs/README.kimi.md)

### OpenCode

OpenCode uses its own plugin install; install Superpowers separately even if you
already use it in another harness.

- Tell OpenCode:

  ```
  Fetch and follow instructions from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/karpotkin/coding-harness/refs/heads/main/.opencode/INSTALL.md
  ```

- Detailed docs: [docs/README.opencode.md](docs/README.opencode.md)

### Pi

Install Superpowers as a Pi package from this repository:

```bash
pi install git:github.com/karpotkin/coding-harness
```

For local development, run Pi with this checkout loaded as a temporary package:

```bash
pi -e /path/to/superpowers
```

The Pi package loads the Superpowers skills and a small extension that injects the `using-superpowers` bootstrap at session startup and again after compaction. Pi has native skills, so no compatibility `Skill` tool is required. Subagent and task-list tools remain optional Pi companion packages.

### Qwen Code

Qwen Code installs plugins from Claude Code marketplaces directly.

- Install the plugin from this repository, and pick `superpowers` when prompted:

  ```bash
  qwen extensions install karpotkin/coding-harness
  ```

- Update later:

  ```bash
  qwen extensions update superpowers
  ```

### Hermes Agent

Install Superpowers as a Hermes plugin from this repository:

```bash
hermes plugins install karpotkin/coding-harness --enable
```

Restart any active Hermes sessions after installing. Note: Hermes has no
post-compaction hook, so a very long session that compacts over its first
turn loses the bootstrap — start a fresh session if skills stop triggering.

### Muse

Superpowers is available as a native Muse plugin — same repo, same skills, all harnesses. The `using-superpowers` bootstrap is injected via the native `SessionStart` hook alongside Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Pi, and the rest — no per-session opt-in.

- Install from a local checkout:

  ```bash
  muse plugins install ./
  muse plugins approve superpowers
  ```

  Or clone and install:

  ```bash
  git clone https://github.com/karpotkin/coding-harness.git
  muse plugins install ./superpowers
  muse plugins approve superpowers
  ```

- Update later:

  ```bash
  muse plugins update superpowers
  ```

Restart any active Muse sessions after installing so the `SessionStart` hook takes effect — skills are active immediately, hooks require approval on first install. To verify, start a fresh session and send `Let's make a react todo list` — a working install auto-triggers `brainstorming` before any code is written. Version is tracked in `.version-bump.json` so `scripts/bump-version.sh` keeps it in sync.

## The Basic Workflow

1. **brainstorming** - Activates before building anything. Draws out what you actually want, and why, through questions that get you describing it, then plays its understanding back for correction. Small changes get agreed in chat; projects get a written design document a builder could plan from.

2. **using-git-worktrees** - Activates after design approval. Creates isolated workspace on new branch, runs project setup, verifies clean test baseline.

3. **writing-plans** - Activates with approved design. Breaks work into bite-sized tasks (2-5 minutes each). Every task has exact file paths, complete code, verification steps.

4. **subagent-driven-development** or **executing-plans** - Activates with plan. Either dispatches a fresh subagent per task with a review after each (most thorough), or implements every task inline in the current session with one fresh review of the whole branch at the end (cheapest).

5. **test-driven-development** - Activates during implementation. Enforces RED-GREEN-REFACTOR: write failing test, watch it fail, write minimal code, watch it pass, commit. Deletes code written before tests.

6. **requesting-code-review** - Activates between tasks. Reviews against plan, reports issues by severity. Critical issues block progress.

7. **finishing-a-development-branch** - Activates when tasks complete. Verifies tests, presents options (merge/PR/keep/discard), cleans up worktree.

**The agent checks for relevant skills before any task.** Mandatory workflows, not suggestions.

## When Something Goes Wrong

Sometimes a session misbehaves: a skill fires when it shouldn't, stays silent when it should, or the agent ignores its plan, repeats work, or burns more tokens than you'd expect. Ask your coding agent to "figure out what went wrong with superpowers in this session" and it will invoke the **diagnosing-superpowers** skill. To examine an earlier session, name it: "figure out what went wrong with superpowers in session `<id>`".

The skill reads the session transcript, reports what happened with line-level evidence, and, if you want, packages a scrubbed bundle for a bug report.

## Community

Superpowers is built by [Jesse Vincent](https://blog.fsck.com) and the rest of the folks at [Prime Radiant](https://primeradiant.com).

- **Discord**: [Join us](https://discord.gg/35wsABTejz) for community support, questions, and sharing what you're building with Superpowers
- **Issues**: https://github.com/karpotkin/coding-harness/issues
- **Release announcements**: [Sign up](https://primeradiant.com/superpowers/) to get notified about new versions

## What's Inside

### Skills Library

**Testing**
- **test-driven-development** - RED-GREEN-REFACTOR cycle (includes testing anti-patterns reference)

**Debugging**
- **systematic-debugging** - 4-phase root cause process (includes root-cause-tracing, defense-in-depth, condition-based-waiting techniques)
- **verification-before-completion** - Ensure it's actually fixed
- **diagnosing-superpowers** - Work out what went wrong in a session, with evidence; export a scrubbed bundle or file an issue

**Collaboration**
- **brainstorming** - Drawing out intent before building
- **writing-plans** - Detailed implementation plans
- **executing-plans** - Inline plan execution: one context, one final review
- **dispatching-parallel-agents** - Concurrent subagent workflows
- **requesting-code-review** - Pre-review checklist
- **receiving-code-review** - Responding to feedback
- **using-git-worktrees** - Parallel development branches
- **finishing-a-development-branch** - Merge/PR decision workflow
- **subagent-driven-development** - Fast iteration with two-stage review (spec compliance, then code quality)

**Meta**
- **writing-skills** - Create new skills following best practices (includes testing methodology)
- **using-superpowers** - Introduction to the skills system

## Philosophy

- **Test-Driven Development** - Write tests first, always
- **Systematic over ad-hoc** - Process over guessing
- **Complexity reduction** - Simplicity as primary goal
- **Evidence over claims** - Verify before declaring success

Read [the original release announcement](https://blog.fsck.com/2025/10/09/superpowers/).

## Contributing

The general contribution process for Superpowers is below. Keep in mind that we don't generally accept contributions of new skills and that any updates to skills must work across all of the coding agents we support. We also don't accept agent-written PRs that fix issues filed by someone else unless a maintainer asked for one, even when you hit the same problem; add your report to the existing issue instead.

1. Fork the repository
2. Switch to the 'dev' branch
3. Create a branch for your work
4. Follow the `writing-skills` skill for creating and testing new and modified skills
5. Submit a PR, filling in every section of the pull request template, including the summary a human writes in their own words.

Skill-behavior tests use the drill eval harness from [superpowers-evals](https://github.com/prime-radiant-inc/superpowers-evals/), cloned into `evals/` — see `evals/README.md` for setup. Plugin-infrastructure tests live at `tests/` and run via the relevant `run-*.sh` or `npm test`.

See `skills/writing-skills/SKILL.md` for the complete guide.

## Updating

Superpowers updates are somewhat coding-agent dependent, but are often automatic.

## License

MIT License - see LICENSE file for details

## Visual companion telemetry

Because skills and plugins don't provide any feedback to creators, we have no idea how many of you are using Superpowers. By default, the Prime Radiant logo on brainstorming's optional visual companion feature is loaded from our website. It includes the version of Superpowers in use. It does not include any details about your project, prompt, or coding agent. We don't see your clicks or anything about what you're building. This helps us have a rough idea of how many folks are using Superpowers and which version of Superpowers they're using. It's 100% optional. To disable this, set the environment variable `SUPERPOWERS_DISABLE_TELEMETRY` to any true value. Superpowers also honors Claude Code's `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC` opt-outs.

# Stealth Search for Claude Code

Let Claude Code search and read the web through your own servers instead of its built-in web tools.

Stealth Search sends searches to your SearXNG and page reads to your Crawl4AI, or to your Browserless if you prefer it or want a backup. Claude gets clean Markdown from fully rendered pages, including JavaScript-heavy docs, and cites the sources it used.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **You must run SearXNG and Crawl4AI yourself.**
> This plugin includes no search engine or crawler and calls no hosted service. It only connects Claude Code to a [SearXNG](https://docs.searxng.org/) instance and a [Crawl4AI](https://docs.crawl4ai.com/) server that you already run, on your machine, your LAN or your own server. A [Browserless](https://docs.browserless.io/) server is optional and can stand in for Crawl4AI. Without a search server and a page reader, the plugin does nothing useful.

## What you get

- **Search** the web through your SearXNG.
- **Read** any page through Crawl4AI or Browserless, with the rendered page turned into Markdown.
- **Research**: search, then read the top results, in one step.
- **Crawl** a documentation section page by page, kept inside that section.
- **No silent fallback.** Claude's built-in `WebSearch` and `WebFetch` are blocked while the plugin is on. If one of your servers is down, you get a clear error, not a quiet switch to a public API. The only switch is to your own Browserless, if you set one up, and every switch shows up in the output.

For Claude Code, there is no MCP server, extra API key or dependency to install. Everything runs on [Bun](https://bun.sh/).

## Before you start

| You need | What it's for |
| --- | --- |
| **Your own SearXNG**, with JSON output enabled (`search.formats` includes `json`) | Finding pages |
| **Your own Crawl4AI server** (0.9.5 compatible API: `/crawl`, `/crawl/stream`, `/md`, `/llm`) and its API token | Opening and rendering pages |
| Optional: **your own Browserless** (v2, `/function`), with or without a token | Fallback or replacement page reader |
| [Bun](https://bun.sh/) on your `PATH` | Running the plugin |
| Claude Code 2.1.319 or newer | Loading the plugin |

Both servers must be reachable from the machine where Claude Code runs.

## Set up

1. Get the plugin:

   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/kolezka/claude-stealth-search-plugin.git
   cd claude-stealth-search-plugin
   ```

2. Point it at your servers. Edit the two URLs in `config.example.sh`, or export them yourself:

   ```bash
   export SEARXNG_URL='http://searxng.example.lan'
   export CRAWL4AI_API_URL='http://crawl4ai.example.lan:11235'
   ```

3. Start Claude Code with the plugin. You type the token in, so it never lands in your shell history or a file:

   ```bash
   source ./config.example.sh
   printf 'Crawl4AI token: '; read -r -s CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN; printf '\n'
   export CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN
   claude --plugin-dir "$PWD"
   ```

`--plugin-dir` turns the plugin on for that session only. Nothing is installed globally. Start Claude without the flag and it's off again.

Keep the token out of `config.example.sh`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.env` files and anything you commit. It's the password to your own Crawl4AI server.

### DeepSeek Harness

The same tree also runs in [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH). The `dsh/` directory holds a small adapter built on [claude-plugins-dsh](https://github.com/kolezka/claude-plugins-dsh). It loads the `crawl` skill and both hooks, so DSH's `web_search` and `web_fetch` are blocked the same way. Claude Code never reads `dsh/`.

Install the adapter's pinned runtime dependency first. Export the same three variables in the shell that starts DSH, then add the adapter through DSH's plugin manager:

```bash
(cd dsh && bun install --frozen-lockfile)
dsh plugin --profile web add "file:$PWD/dsh"
```

After installing the dependency, you can instead turn it on for every profile with a row in `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: claude-compat-stealth-search
      name: "file:///abs/path/to/claude-stealth-search-plugin/dsh/index.js"
```

In DSH the skill is called `crawl`, not `stealth-search:crawl`. Hooks need `bun` on the `PATH` and a POSIX shell.

## Use it

Ask Claude to look something up and it will use your servers. You can also call the skill directly:

```text
/crawl What changed in the latest Python release? Cite sources.
/crawl Read https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons
/crawl Collect up to 5 pages from the Apple HIG and summarise the navigation guidance.
```

If another plugin already uses `/crawl`, use the full name `/stealth-search:crawl`.

## Good to know

- **Your servers, your engines.** SearXNG still sends your queries to whichever upstream engines you enabled on it.
- **The model isn't local.** Search and crawling run on your servers, but the page text still goes to the model provider your Claude Code session uses.
- **A guard, not a firewall.** The plugin blocks Claude's two built-in web tools and points Claude at your servers. It doesn't block other MCP search tools or `curl`. A plugin that needs a specific web provider may clash with it, so turn this one on only when you want this setup.
- **Crawls are bounded.** By default a crawl reads up to 5 pages, one link deep, inside the starting section. Claude tells you when it stopped early or cut a long page short.
- **Use HTTPS if your network isn't trusted.** The token goes to Crawl4AI with every page read.

## Command line

Claude calls a small CLI for you, and you can run it yourself:

```bash
bun scripts/web.ts search 'self-hosted search engines' --limit 5
bun scripts/web.ts fetch 'https://example.com/docs/page' --css-selector main
bun scripts/web.ts research 'self-hosted search engines' --limit 3
bun scripts/web.ts crawl 'https://example.com/docs/' --max-pages 5 --max-depth 1
bun scripts/web.ts fetch 'https://example.com/app' --endpoint stream
bun scripts/web.ts fetch 'https://example.com/docs/page' --endpoint md --filter bm25 --query 'install'
bun scripts/web.ts ask 'https://example.com/docs/page' 'Which versions are supported?'
```

`search` needs only `SEARXNG_URL`. `fetch` and `crawl` need a page reader (see below). `ask` needs `CRAWL4AI_API_URL` and `CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN`. `research` needs SearXNG and a reader. Run `bun scripts/web.ts --help` for every option.

`--endpoint` picks the Crawl4AI API that reads the page: `crawl` (batch, default), `stream` (`/crawl/stream`) or `md` (`/md`, with `--filter fit|raw|bm25|llm` and `--query`). `md` returns no title or links, so `crawl` accepts only `crawl` and `stream`. `ask` uses `/llm`, which needs an LLM provider configured on the Crawl4AI server; without one the server returns HTTP 500 and the command fails. An empty Markdown body or answer is reported as `empty_content`, never as a page.

`crawl` and `stream` always ask for a stealth browser: playwright-stealth, a 1920x1080 viewport, and a fresh user agent. The server rejects `simulate_user`, `override_navigator` and `magic` from API clients, so those stay on the server config. `/md` and `/llm` cannot take a browser config. A failed read puts `status_code` and `error_message` on `error` when the server sent them.

### Browserless

Browserless reads pages through its `/function` API: Chrome loads the page and turns it into Markdown with title and links. Set it up next to Crawl4AI:

```bash
export BROWSERLESS_API_URL='http://browserless.example.lan:3000'
export BROWSERLESS_API_TOKEN=...          # only if your Browserless needs one
export STEALTH_SEARCH_READER=auto         # auto (default), crawl4ai or browserless
```

| Reader | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| `auto` | Crawl4AI reads. If `BROWSERLESS_API_URL` is set and Crawl4AI fails, Browserless reads instead. Without `BROWSERLESS_API_URL` it behaves exactly like `crawl4ai`. |
| `crawl4ai` | Only Crawl4AI. Never falls back. |
| `browserless` | Only Browserless. Crawl4AI settings are not needed. |

`--reader` on `fetch`, `research` and `crawl` overrides `STEALTH_SEARCH_READER` for one command. Each page has a `reader` field. Each switch adds a line to `warnings` with the Crawl4AI error. If Crawl4AI is unreachable, misconfigured or returns an HTTP error, the rest of that command goes straight to Browserless. If only one page fails, the next page tries Crawl4AI again. If Browserless fails too, the error includes the Crawl4AI failure in `fallback_from`. An out-of-scope redirect during a crawl never triggers a fallback.

Browserless supports `--css-selector` and `--wait-for` (`css:SELECTOR` or `js:EXPRESSION`) but not `--endpoint stream|md`, `--filter` or `--query`. `ask` always uses Crawl4AI.

Every command prints JSON. Success has `"ok": true`. A failure has `"ok": false` and an `error` object, and exits with code 1. Bad arguments exit with code 2.

<details>
<summary>Limits and edge cases</summary>

- Defaults: 5 search results, 3 research results, 5 crawl pages, depth 1, 16,000 Markdown characters per page.
- Maximums: 20 results or fetch URLs, 100 crawl pages, depth 10, 200,000 characters per page.
- Responses over 8 MiB fail. Each request times out after 60 seconds. Browserless gives a page 30 seconds to load.
- API redirects are refused, so the token can't be forwarded to another host.
- A crawl stays on the starting site and path. Hitting a limit gives `complete: false` and a warning. If a crawl fails partway, the error output still includes the pages collected so far.
- Final page URLs are checked, but Crawl4AI may already have followed a browser redirect by then. This is not SSRF protection.
- SearXNG engine problems (CAPTCHA, timeouts) show up in `warnings`. Zero results while engines are failing is an error, not "nothing found".
- The CLI writes no files or caches. Both tokens are masked in all output.

</details>

## Development

```bash
bun install          # TypeScript and Bun types, for the type check only
(cd dsh && bun install --frozen-lockfile)  # DSH adapter tests
bun test
bun run typecheck
claude plugin validate --strict --json .
```

Tests run against a local HTTP fixture with a fake token. Passing tests show the hooks and CLI behave correctly. They don't show that a live Claude session picks this route, so check that by hand.

`tests/browserless-live.test.ts` checks the Browserless Markdown converter in a real browser. It is skipped unless you point it at a Browserless that can reach your machine:

```bash
docker run -d --rm -p 127.0.0.1:3000:3000 ghcr.io/browserless/chromium
BROWSERLESS_E2E_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000 bun test tests/browserless-live.test.ts
```

Set `BROWSERLESS_E2E_HOST` if the browser can't reach this machine as `host.docker.internal`, and `BROWSERLESS_API_TOKEN` if your Browserless needs one.

The adapter imports the published `claude-plugin-dsh` runtime directly. After changing its pinned dependency, run `bun install` in `dsh/` and commit the updated `dsh/bun.lock`. To inspect the adapter after installing its dependencies:

```bash
bun x claude-plugin-dsh@0.2.0 inspect "$PWD"
```

## Disclaimer

Unofficial plugin. Not affiliated with Anthropic, SearXNG or Crawl4AI.

# @kulebbb/dsh-git-tree

中文 · [English](README.en.md)

DSH 桌面端（DeepSeek Harness.app）右侧栏插件：在右侧栏的标签页里用图形展示**当前会话所属项目**的 git 提交/分支 DAG。它和文件、浏览器、终端是同一套 tab 机制——展开右侧栏 → 点「＋」打开开始页 → 点「Git 提交图」卡片，或按 `⌘⇧G`（Windows / Linux 为 `Ctrl+Shift+G`）。

项目不需要选择：面板直接跟随会话的工作目录，切换会话即切换项目；每个会话的右侧栏布局相互独立（在哪个会话打开过，就在哪个会话里出现）。

> **平台支持**：自 **v0.7.0** 起只支持 **DSH 桌面端**，不再支持 `dsh web`。需要带右侧栏的 DSH 版本（0.2.x）。
>
> 本插件由社区维护，不是 DeepSeek 官方组件。

仓库：<https://github.com/kulebbb/dsh-git-tree> · npm：<https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kulebbb/dsh-git-tree>

本包是一个 **bundle（组合包）**：`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向自带的 `cordis.patch.yml`，因此可以被 DSH 桌面端的「插件」页直接安装、启用和卸载，不需要手工编辑 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。

版本脉络见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/kulebbb/dsh-git-tree/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。

## 截图

![DSH 桌面端右侧栏中的 Git 提交图](assets/sidebar-graph.png)

## 安装（桌面端）

从 Git 安装的地址是 `github:kulebbb/dsh-git-tree`。要钉住一次提交，写成 `github:kulebbb/dsh-git-tree#<40位commit>`。仓库里的 `lib/` 就是运行入口（已提交的 JavaScript，不是待编译的 TypeScript），没有 `build` / `prepare`。从 Git 安装不会编译，也不需要在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里为本包打开 `allowBuilds`。

npm 上的公开包名是 `@kulebbb/dsh-git-tree`（维护者即本仓库；**0.7.0 起**为桌面端专用版本，0.4.0 及更早会被插件页以「不是组合包」拒绝）。无作用域的 `dsh-git-tree` 是另一个作者的包，不要装那个。

桌面端 App 独占名为 `desktop` 的 profile。独立安装的 `dsh` CLI（已在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1` 上核对）遇到这个名字会直接拒绝：`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`。不要往 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop` 里 `pnpm add`，也不要用 CLI 启停 App。安装、更新、卸载走「插件」页：

1. 侧边栏打开「插件」页 → 安装，填入下面任一地址：
   - Git：`github:kulebbb/dsh-git-tree`（也可粘贴 `https://github.com/kulebbb/dsh-git-tree`；改动未发版时用这个）
   - npm：`@kulebbb/dsh-git-tree`
2. 安装完成后按提示**重启 DeepSeek Harness**（桌面端没有 HMR，重启后新插件才生效）。
3. 重启后展开右侧栏 → 点「＋」打开开始页 → 点「Git 提交图」卡片。

自己的、名字不是 `desktop` 的 profile，可以用官方 CLI 装进组合层（界面仍然只在桌面端右侧栏出现，`dsh web` 不支持本插件）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:kulebbb/dsh-git-tree
```

也可以用 agent 的 `plugin_manager` 工具安装：`action: install_bundle`，`target` 填 `github:kulebbb/dsh-git-tree` 或 `@kulebbb/dsh-git-tree`。

**更新与卸载**：桌面端没有「更新」按钮，更新＝在「插件」页重新安装新版本（插件管理器会覆盖安装并提示重启）；卸载也在「插件」页，若提示需要先停止 DSH，按提示退出 App 后再操作。

## 使用

面板顶部的状态条显示项目名、分支、领先/落后，以及本地与云端 HEAD。悬停提交行会看到完整提交说明和代码变动量；过长的标题会以省略号截断，提交图不会出现横向滚动条。

接口、payload，以及状态条与 tooltip 的实现细节见 [docs/api.md](https://github.com/kulebbb/dsh-git-tree/blob/main/docs/api.md)。

## 新版本提示

插件启动时**静默**检查 npm registry 是否有新版本（不阻塞启动、离线时自动降级、不产生日志噪音）：

- 打开 Git 面板后，状态行下方显示细横幅：「新版本 {latest}（当前 {current}），请在 DSH 侧边栏「插件」页重装以更新」。
- 桌面端不提供「更新」按钮：桌面 profile 由 App 独占管理，安装/更新都交给「插件」页（对非官方插件是「重装新版本」）。
- 横幅可 ✕ 关闭；关闭状态只保留在当前面板实例内，面板重新挂载时会重新检查。

## 从旧版本升级

从 v0.4.0（手工改过 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`）升级时，先删掉旧的 `insert git-tree` 行，再在「插件」页安装 0.7.2，否则同一 id 会有两条来源；v0.5.0 / 0.6.0 直接重装即可。若曾装在 `dsh web` 的 profile 里，0.7.0 起请移除（`pnpm remove`，并按当时的装法清理 patch 或 `dsh.profile.bundles`）。不要点 v0.4.0 自带的「更新」按钮。逐步说明（含要删除的 YAML）见 [docs/upgrade.md](https://github.com/kulebbb/dsh-git-tree/blob/main/docs/upgrade.md)。

## 🤖 Agent 一键安装

把下面**任一段**提示词（中文或英文）复制发给你的 AI 助手（DeepSeek / Claude / Cursor 等），它会自动完成安装。如需同时安装 [dsh-vision](https://github.com/kulebbb/dsh-vision)，把两个插件的提示词一起发给助手，它会依次完成。

**中文版**

```text
你是一个安装助手。请帮我把 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）桌面端插件 @kulebbb/dsh-git-tree 安装到桌面端 profile（desktop）。

【背景】
@kulebbb/dsh-git-tree 是一个 bundle：自带 cordis.patch.yml，会在 DSH 右侧栏注册一个「Git 提交图」标签页（与文件、浏览器、终端同级），打开后展示当前会话所属项目的 git 提交/分支图。无第三方运行时依赖，仅支持 DSH 桌面端（不支持 dsh web）。

【安装步骤】
1. 先检查桌面端 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml：如果里面已有 id 为 git-tree 的插入行（v0.4.0 的老装法），先删掉那段再继续，否则同一 id 会有两条来源。
2. 优先使用 plugin_manager 工具的 install_bundle，target 填 github:kulebbb/dsh-git-tree 或 @kulebbb/dsh-git-tree（未发版时用 Git 地址）。
3. 如果没有 plugin_manager 工具或调用被拒绝，告诉我用侧边栏「插件」页安装，并说明步骤。
4. 不要手工编辑桌面端 profile 的 package.json 或 cordis.patch.yml，也不要在 profile 目录里跑 pnpm——桌面端的 profile 由 App 独占管理。

【验证】
- 安装结果里 application 为 applied 或 restart-required；restart-required 时需要重启 DeepSeek Harness。
- 重启后：展开右侧栏 → 点「＋」→ 点「Git 提交图」卡片，面板展示当前会话项目的提交/分支图。

【异常处理】
- 任何错误把完整信息原样转达给我，不要自行改配置或换方案。
- 需要我确认的信息先问我，再继续。
```

**English**

```text
You are an installation assistant. Install the DSH (DeepSeek Harness) desktop plugin @kulebbb/dsh-git-tree into the desktop profile.

[Context]
@kulebbb/dsh-git-tree is a bundle: it ships its own cordis.patch.yml and registers a "Git commit graph" tab in the DSH right sidebar (alongside Files, Browser and Terminal) that renders the commit/branch graph of the current session's project. No third-party runtime dependencies. Desktop app only — `dsh web` is not supported.

[Install]
1. First check the desktop profile's cordis.patch.yml: if it already has an insert row with id git-tree (the v0.4.0 setup), delete that block first — otherwise the same id comes from two layers.
2. Prefer the plugin_manager tool with action install_bundle and target github:kulebbb/dsh-git-tree or @kulebbb/dsh-git-tree (use the Git target for unreleased changes).
3. If plugin_manager is unavailable or refused, tell me to install it from the sidebar Plugins page and give the steps.
4. Do not hand-edit the desktop profile's package.json or cordis.patch.yml, and do not run pnpm in the profile directory — the desktop app owns its profile.

[Verify]
- The install result reports application applied or restart-required; when it is restart-required, restart DeepSeek Harness.
- After restart: expand the right sidebar, click "+", and choose the "Git commit graph" card; the panel shows the current session project's commit/branch graph.

[On errors]
- Relay the full error verbatim; do not improvise config changes or fall back to other approaches.
- Ask me before continuing whenever you need information I have not provided.
```

## 安全说明

graph 只在宿主记录的当前会话工作区内执行 git：工作区根来自 `ctx.workspaceRegistry.list()` 中包含该会话的记录的 `path`；注册表没有这条会话时，回退到 `ctx.sessions.get(sessionId).header.cwd`。`cwd` 与工作区根都会做 `realpath`，结果必须等于根或位于其下（按路径边界判断，`/a/b` 不会误放行 `/a/bc`）。越界、目录不存在，或经 `..` / 符号链接逃出工作区，返回 `400` + `invalid-cwd`。请保持 web server 绑定在回环地址（默认 `127.0.0.1`）；不要用 `--host 0.0.0.0` 暴露到网络。

## 结构

| 文件 | 职责 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | Node half：在 webserver 注册 `GET /git-tree/graph?session=&cwd=&n=` 与 `GET /git-tree/update/status`。两条路由先经 `ctx.connection.admit()`；graph 的 cwd 限制在当前会话工作区内。只读，不写 profile |
| `lib/client.js` | Browser half：注册右侧栏 tab 类型（`git-tree`）+ 开始页卡片 + SVG 提交图（`__ModuleLoader__` bundle） |
| `lib/git.js` / `lib/parse.js` | 进程调用与纯解析器 |
| `lib/update.js` | 版本比较与 npm registry 最新版本查询 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle patch：把本包插入为 `git-tree` 加载项 |
| `locale/*.json` / `icon.svg` | 插件页展示用的标题、描述与图标 |
| `docs/decisions/` | 架构决策记录（含「只支持桌面端」的决定） |
| `test/` | node --test 单测 + 夹具仓库脚本（仅仓库，不随 npm 包发布） |

## 测试

```sh
node --test          # 在仓库根目录；零依赖，用系统 node 运行即可
```

# 抖音转OB（初学者适用）— 抖音视频 → Obsidian 知识库

> 一个简单的人工提供抖音链接（可通过抖音PC客户端获得），由本插件自动将视频内容转化文字记录，并自动导入到Obsidian中，适用于harness、个人知识库搭建初学者上手。也是本人使用harness完全借助deepseek创建的第一个插件，具备实验性质：-）

把抖音视频（单条分享链接或博主主页批量）下载下来，离线转写成带时间戳的中文文字稿，写成 Markdown 笔记放进本机 Obsidian Vault。

安装后左侧栏会多出一个「抖音转OB」图标：里面只有三个部分——粘贴抖音链接的录入框、**开始抓取**按钮、以及注意事项，不熟悉命令行的使用者也能直接用。

- **抓取**：Playwright 驱动本机 Edge 的持久化配置目录，先拿 `ttwid` 等 Cookie，再打开视频页，在页面自身的 `response` 回调里截获 `/aweme/v1/web/aweme/detail/` 的 `aweme_detail`（yt-dlp 对抖音已失效，见“背景”）。
- **转写**：sherpa-onnx + SenseVoice（中英日韩粤，int8 模型约 228 MiB）+ silero VAD 切段，纯本地、离线、无 API key。
- **落库**：YAML frontmatter + 视频文案 + `- \`mm:ss\` 句子` 形式的转写 + 要点区，封面存 `抖音收藏/_附件/`，去重索引 `抖音收藏/.index.json`。

## 安装

```sh
# 1. 从 GitHub 仓库（推荐）
dsh plugin add github:KunWu1980/dsh-douyin-kb

# 2. 从本地目录（开发时用，link 安装）
dsh plugin add C:\path\to\douyin-kb-plugin
```

桌面版也可以在 **设置 → 插件** 里用“安装插件”填上面同样的 spec；或让 Agent 调用 `plugin_manager install_bundle`。

> 更新已安装的 bundle 后需要重启应用，宿主才会加载新的 JS 模块代际；`application: applied` 只代表 profile 已写入。

## 运行时前置

插件本身零 npm 依赖，但它调用的 Python 脚本需要：

| 依赖 | 用途 | 安装 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Node.js ≥ 20（含 npm） | 宿主运行插件 | 已随 DSH 提供 |
| Python 3.10+ | 执行 `assets/douyin_kb.py` | 系统 Python 或 DSH 自带运行时 |
| `playwright` | 驱动 Edge 抓取抖音页面 | `python -m pip install playwright`（用 `channel="msedge"`，无需下载 Chromium） |
| `av` (PyAV) | 无 ffmpeg 时解码音轨 | `python -m pip install av` |
| `sherpa-onnx` | 离线语音转写 + VAD | `python -m pip install sherpa-onnx` |
| `numpy` | 音频重采样 | pip |
| SenseVoice 模型 | 中文转写 | `model.int8.onnx` + `tokens.txt` 放到 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\douyin-kb\models\` |
| silero VAD | 语音切段 | `silero_vad.onnx` 同目录（缺失会退化为 25s 定长切块） |

模型下载（国内镜像）：

```powershell
# SenseVoice（约 228 MiB）
curl.exe -L -o "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\douyin-kb\models\model.int8.onnx" `
  https://hf-mirror.com/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-sense-voice-zh-en-ja-ko-yue-2024-07-17/resolve/main/model.int8.onnx
curl.exe -L -o "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\douyin-kb\models\tokens.txt" `
  https://hf-mirror.com/csukuangfj/sherpa-onnx-sense-voice-zh-en-ja-ko-yue-2024-07-17/resolve/main/tokens.txt
# silero VAD（约 2.2 MiB）
curl.exe -L -o "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\douyin-kb\models\silero_vad.onnx" `
  https://hf-mirror.com/onnx-community/silero-vad/resolve/main/onnx/model.onnx
```

## 配置

| 配置项 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `vault` | 自动识别（Obsidian 当前打开的库） | 也支持环境变量 `OBSIDIAN_VAULT` 或本地 `config.json` 覆盖 |
| `kbHome` | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\douyin-kb` | 模型、浏览器配置、下载缓存；也可用 `DOUYIN_KB_HOME` |
| `python` | 自动探测 | 指定 Python 可执行文件；也可用 `DOUYIN_KB_PYTHON` |
| `timeoutSeconds` | `900` | 单次工具调用超时 |

本机专属设置**不需要手动填写**：插件会读 Obsidian 自己的 `obsidian.json`，用“当前打开的那个库”作为 `vault`。只有在你想覆盖时才需要额外指定——写在插件目录之外的 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\douyin-kb\config.json`（该文件不在仓库里，也不会随插件发布）：

```json
{ "vault": "D:\\path\\to\\Obsidian Vault" }
```

读取优先级：插件配置 `vault` → 环境变量 `OBSIDIAN_VAULT` → `config.json` 的 `vault` → Obsidian 当前打开的库 → 默认 `%USERPROFILE%\Documents\Obsidian Vault`。

## 左侧栏面板（初学者推荐）

安装并重启 DeepSeek Harness 后，左侧栏出现「抖音转OB」图标：

1. 把抖音分享链接（或整段分享文案）粘进录入框；
2. 点 **开始抓取**，面板显示进度，抓完会给出笔记路径；
3. 首次使用会弹出浏览器窗口要求扫码登录抖音，用手机抖音扫一次即可，之后无需重复。

面板下方固定展示三条注意事项：首次扫码登录、离线语音模型偶有错字需人工校对、使用前需自行安装 Node.js / Git / Python。

## 斜杠命令

```text
/douyin https://v.douyin.com/xxxxxx/
```

与面板按钮等价（同样走 `force=true` 覆盖写），适合在会话里直接触发。

## 工具用法

Agent 侧工具名 `douyin_kb`：

```jsonc
{ "action": "ingest", "target": "7.66 12/31 ... https://v.douyin.com/xxxx/", "force": false }
{ "action": "batch",  "target": "https://www.douyin.com/user/MS4wLjABAAAA...", "limit": 5 }
{ "action": "probe",  "target": "https://www.douyin.com/video/7703889641270775066" }
{ "action": "login" }
```

命令行等价物（排错时用）：

```powershell
python assets/douyin_kb.py ingest "https://v.douyin.com/xxxx/" --vault "D:\path\to\Obsidian Vault"
python assets/douyin_kb.py probe 7703889641270775066
```

## 常见问题

- **`Fresh cookies (not necessarily logged in) are needed` / HTTP 403**：抖音风控。本插件走浏览器截获，不使用 yt-dlp；若页面出现 `data-e2e="error-page"`，先 `action=login` 扫码，或删掉 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\douyin-kb\browser-profile` 重来。无头模式会被判定为机器人，默认有头。
- **`aweme_detail: null` + `filter_reason: "core_dep"`**：视频区域/内容受限，换片源。
- **转写为空**：视频无语音、音量过低，或 VAD 误切；可先 `action=probe` 确认时长。
- **中文乱码**：PowerShell 里跑命令行版时先 `[Console]::OutputEncoding = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8`。

## 目录

```
douyin-kb-plugin/
├─ index.js              # 宿主侧：注册 douyin_kb 工具与 /douyin 命令，spawn Python
├─ client.js             # 客户端：左侧栏图标 + 主面板（录入框 / 开始抓取 / 注意事项）
├─ package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client 清单
├─ cordis.patch.yml      # 插入插件行
├─ locale/{en,zh}.json   # 插件名与描述
├─ icon.svg
└─ assets/douyin_kb.py   # 抓取 + 下载 + 转写 + 写笔记
```

## 背景：为什么不用 yt-dlp

yt-dlp 的抖音提取器要求站点 Cookie 里有 `s_v_web_id`，且 `/aweme/v1/web/aweme/detail/` 可直接请求；实测伪造 Cookie 无效、裸请求 403、`iesdouyin` 分享页已不含 `videoInfoRes`。唯一稳定通道是让真实浏览器自己发请求，再从响应里取数据。

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-session-index

> DSH（DeepSeek Harness）+ WorkBuddy 的**全会话索引与跨会话记忆** MCP 插件。
> 拉取仓库 → 双击安装 → 之后全自动。零第三方依赖，源会话文件全程只读。

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 版本 | **v2.4.0** |
| 运行要求 | Node **≥ 22.15**（需要 `zlib.zstdDecompressSync`） |
| MCP 能力 | **13 个工具** / 4 个提示词 / 8 个资源 |
| 第三方依赖 | **0**（只用 Node 标准库） |
| 完整手册 | [`操作使用手册.html`](./操作使用手册.html)（单页 14 章，导航 / 搜索 / 一键复制） |

---

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 的会话存在 `~/.dsh/sessions/` 下，是**上千个独立 zstd 帧拼接**的 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd`，单文件可达 20 MB。
想在新会话里回顾旧结论，只能整包解压翻全文——慢，而且极耗 token。

本插件把全部会话**预先索引成结构化记忆单元**（会话卡：提问、结论、涉及路径、工具、关键词、血缘），
之后一次工具调用就能拿到结论速览，用关键词只取命中片段，**不必再把几十 MB 历史灌进上下文**。

---

## 安装

### 方式 A：DSH 插件页（推荐 · 零命令行）

1. 打开 DSH → **插件页**
2. 粘贴仓库地址：`https://github.com/Lau-Jin/DSH`
3. 点安装，按提示**完全退出 DSH 再打开**（最小化无效）

装完就是可用状态，不用改配置、不用跑脚本、不用管 Node 路径。

**它为什么能自己找到入口**——插件包里的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会随 bundle 自动应用，挂两行：

| 行 id | 包 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `session-index-host` | `dsh-session-index` | 宿主半身（`lib/index.mjs`）：用 `import.meta.url` 解析**真实安装目录**，把 `server.mjs` 绝对路径写进 `~/.dsh/session-index/server-path.txt` |
| `mcp-session-index` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` | MCP stdio 客户端：13 工具 / 4 提示词 / 8 资源 |

那行配置里的 `command`、`args`、`DSH_HOME` 三处都是 `!!js` 表达式，**在 DSH 加载配置时求值**（不是安装时），
按「显式环境变量 → 宿主记下的路径文件 → profile 标准安装位置」依次探测。
所以仓库放哪、pnpm 装到哪、换了 Node 版本，都不需要改文件。

宿主行排在前、MCP 行排在后，路径文件先落盘，MCP 侧首次 spawn 就能命中——**一次重启即生效**。

### 方式 B：clone + 一键脚本（想自己控制目录 / 离线分发）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Lau-Jin/DSH.git
cd DSH
```

然后：

- **Windows**：双击 `install.cmd`
- **macOS / Linux / Git Bash**：`./install.sh`

`install.mjs` 会先判断 profile 是否已经以 bundle 方式注册了本插件：

- **已注册**（你从插件页装过）→ 不再写 profile 配置，只把残留的旧配置块清掉，避免出现两条同 id 的 MCP 行；
- **未注册**（纯 clone 用户）→ 往 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 写一个带标记的配置块。

两种情况都会：写好 `server-path.txt`、装 Skill、生成可分发包。

### 方式 C：手动加 MCP（不推荐，仅排障用）

DSH「MCP 与技能」→ MCP 里添加 stdio server：

| 字段 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 名称 | `session-index` |
| command | `node` 的绝对路径（需 ≥ 22.15） |
| args | `<仓库目录>/server.mjs` |

### 前置条件

1. **Node ≥ 22.15** —— 需要 `zlib.zstdDecompressSync`。插件页安装时会自动挑 DSH 自带的 Node（`~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/*/dependencies/node`），通常不用你操心。
2. 方式 B 需要 **Git**；仓库已转公开，无需 SSH key。

### 安装脚本做了什么

`install.cmd` / `install.sh` 只是包装，实际调用 `node install.mjs`：

1. 解析可用的 Node（含 zstd 支持校验）
2. 判断安装方式（bundle / patch），必要时**备份**并写入 `cordis.patch.yml` 的标记块
3. 写 `~/.dsh/session-index/server-path.txt`，记下 MCP 入口绝对路径
4. 安装 Skill 到 `~/.dsh/skills/session-index/SKILL.md`
5. 自动生成插件包与技能包到 `dist/`
6. 打印 6 项校验结果

幂等：重复运行不会产生重复条目；**更新后重跑会保留你手工改过的 env 值**（除非显式加 `--reset-env`）。

---

## 装上之后是自动的

| 行为 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 首次建索引 | server 启动时后台子进程构建，**不阻塞 MCP 握手**；未就绪时工具会提示稍候 |
| 新会话识别 | `fs.watch` 递归监听 DSH 与 WorkBuddy 会话目录，写入停止约 3.5 秒后增量纳入 |
| 定时兜底 | 每 60 秒增量刷新，只处理 size/mtime 变化的文件 |
| 安静期保护 | 已有索引的活跃会话需静止 45 秒才重建，避免反复解压正在写入的大文件 |
| 客户端通知 | 索引更新后发 `notifications/resources/list_changed`，客户端无需重启即可感知 |
| 自愈 | 索引缺失或损坏时，下次启动自动重建 |

本机实测（31 个会话）：全量构建 **约 10 秒**、索引 **约 12 MB**（源文件 55 MB+）；
增量刷新 **约 0.85 秒**，无变化时 **约 30 ms**；新会话从写入到可检索 **约 70 ms**。

---

## 工具速览

推荐调用链：`status → brief → related/thread → search → get`，逐级放大，避免一上来灌全文。

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `session_index_status` | 索引与自动维护状态（含监听、下次刷新倒计时） |
| `session_index_brief` | 跨会话结论速览；带 `query` 只取相关主题 |
| `session_index_list` | 会话清单（标题 / 时间 / 工作区 / 应用） |
| `session_index_related` | 相关会话 + 关联理由（共享路径 / 关键词 / 工具 / 血缘 / 同工作区） |
| `session_index_thread` | 父子血缘链（compact 上游、subagent 下游、同源兄弟） |
| `session_index_search` | 语义检索，**只返回命中片段**；默认排除系统注入噪声 |
| `session_index_get` | 先看会话骨架，再按 `seq` 精确取原文 |
| `session_index_remember` | 写入长期记忆（类型 / 标签 / 重要度） |
| `session_index_recall` | 召回长期记忆（时间衰减排序） |
| `session_index_forget` | 归档或删除记忆（默认归档） |
| `session_index_refresh` | 手动增量刷新 |
| `session_index_package` | 重新生成分发包 |
| `session_index_vectors` | 可选的向量索引管理 |

另提供提示词 `session-context` / `resume-topic` / `catch-up` / `quickstart`，
资源 `session-index://guide`、`://plugin.json`、`://status`、`://brief`、`://memory` 等。
`initialize` 会返回 `instructions`，客户端不读外部文档也能正确上手。

**搜索模式**：`semantic`（默认，本地同义词扩展 + BM25，零 token）、`keyword`（精确 AND）、
`hybrid` / `vector`（需配置 embedding，未配置自动降级为本地语义检索）。

---

## 更新 / 校验 / 回滚

```bash
# Windows
update.cmd              # git pull + 重装（保留 env 自定义）

# macOS / Linux
./update.sh
```

```bash
node install.mjs --verify        # 6 项状态校验
node install.mjs --dry-run       # 预览改动，不写文件
node install.mjs --uninstall     # 移除配置块与自动装的 Skill（先备份）
node install.mjs --reset-env     # 用默认值覆盖 env 自定义
node smoke.mjs                   # 66 项端到端自测

## 分发包（离线 / 无 git 环境）

`install.mjs` 每次运行会自动生成：

| 文件 | 内容 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `dist/dsh-session-index-v2.4.0.zip` | 全部源码 + 清单 + 文档 + 手册 + 脚本 + `MANIFEST.json` + `INSTALL.md` | 完整分发，解压后双击 `install.cmd` |
| `dist/session-index-skill-v2.4.0.zip` | 根 `SKILL.md` + 说明 | 直接导入 DSH「MCP 与技能」 |

包内**排除**：索引分片 `*.jsonl.gz`、`meta/cards/notes/vectors.json`、备份与临时文件、已有 zip。
已验证包内无任何会话数据与密钥，可安全分发。也可随时 `node pack.mjs` 重打，或调 MCP 工具 `session_index_package`。

---

## 配置项

全部通过配置块的 `env` 设置。改哪里取决于安装方式：

- **插件页安装**：改插件包内的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-index/cordis.patch.yml`），改完重启 DSH；
- **clone + 脚本**：改 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 里 `>>> session-index` 标记块内的 `env`，重跑 `node install.mjs` 会保留你写的值。

| 变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `SESSION_INDEX_AUTO` | `1` | 总开关，`0` 关闭后台自动维护 |
| `SESSION_INDEX_AUTO_INTERVAL_MS` | `60000` | 定时增量刷新间隔（最小 15000） |
| `SESSION_INDEX_AUTO_QUIET_MS` | `45000` | 已有会话的静止期（活跃时不重建） |
| `SESSION_INDEX_WATCH` | `1` | 文件事件监听开关 |
| `SESSION_INDEX_WATCH_DEBOUNCE_MS` | `3500` | 写入事件防抖 |
| `SESSION_INDEX_WATCH_QUIET_MS` | `6000` | 监听路径的静止期 |
| `SESSION_INDEX_APPS` | `all` | 只索引 `dsh` 或 `workbuddy` |
| `SESSION_INDEX_DIR` | `~/.dsh/session-index` | 索引产物目录 |
| `SESSION_INDEX_EMBED_URL` / `_MODEL` / `_KEY` | 空 | 可选，OpenAI 兼容 embedding；不配则纯本地 |

> 改完这些值后**不要加 `--reset-env`**；正常重跑安装会保留它们。

---

索引产物写入 `~/.dsh/session-index/`，**与仓库目录分离**，所以换 clone 位置不会丢索引。

---

## 隐私与安全

- **源会话只读**：任何操作都不修改 `~/.dsh/sessions/` 与 `~/.workbuddy/projects/` 下的原始文件。
- **配置写前备份**：每次改 `cordis.patch.yml` 都先复制为 `.bak-<时间戳>`。
- **不入库**：索引、长期记忆、备份、验证产物均在 `.gitignore` 中排除。
- **索引含会话原文**：`~/.dsh/session-index/` 是会话全文的本地副本，**不要打包外传**；分发请用 `dist/` 里的 zip（已自动排除）。

---

## 卸载

- **插件页安装的**：插件页里禁用或卸载 `dsh-session-index`，重启 DSH 即可（MCP 行随 bundle 一起消失）。
- **clone + 脚本安装的**：`node install.mjs --uninstall`，移除配置块与自动安装的 Skill（先备份）。

两种情况下索引目录 `~/.dsh/session-index/` 都保留（不影响原始会话），需要时手动删除。

---

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
dsh-hero-theme

A HeroUI v3 theme builder for DeepSeek Harness Web and the embedded Desktop workspace.
Six live controls regenerate the complete DSH token layer — no rebuild, no profile restart.

English · 中文

## Preview

Preview renders of the generated light and dark palettes in a representative DSH layout.

## Highlights | | | | --- | --- | | **Six live controls** | Accent hue, Base chroma, Font Family, Radius, Radius Form, Light / Dark / System. | | **167 tokens × 2 schemes** | Every alias, specific, Shiki, radius, shadow and timing token is regenerated from the config. | | **HeroUI builder formulas** | Accent `oklch(62.04% 0.195 hue)`, neutral chroma scaling, semantic hue rotation, radius scale. | | **Component geometry** | HeroUI Slider, Tabs, Select, Button, MenuSurface, Dialog and Tooltip geometry plus enter/exit motion. | | **No rebuild loop** | Changes apply through one `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` layer and persist to the profile Cordis patch. | | **Reduced motion aware** | All added transitions and enter/exit animations stop under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. | ## Theme builder

Settings → General → HeroUI theme. The sliders, Tabs and Select are HeroUI-styled controls.

| Control | Range | Default | What it changes | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Accent | hue `0–360` | `253.83` | Accent `oklch(62.04% 0.195 hue)` (`#0485F7` at the default), focus ring, gradient start | | Base | chroma `0–0.02` | `0.0015` | Chroma of every neutral (background, surfaces, text, borders) | | Font Family | Inter / System UI / Geist / Manrope / IBM Plex Sans / JetBrains Mono | Inter | `--dsw-font-family` and the brand stack | | Radius | `0–1.25rem` | `0.5rem` (8px) | HeroUI radius scale and card radius (`3×`) | | Radius Form | `0–1.5rem` | `0.75rem` (12px) | Inputs and form fields | | Theme | Light / Dark / System | Dark | Base color scheme and `ctx.theme.setTheme()` | The default accent is HeroUI blue `#0485F7` at hue `253.83`; the secondary gradient color is generated 31.67° around the wheel toward the HeroUI violet. Fonts must be installed locally — the stack falls back to System UI. ## Generated palette The generator mirrors the HeroUI v3 theme builder formulas: | Token | Light | Dark | | --- | --- | --- | | background | `oklch(97.02% base hue)` | `oklch(12.00% base hue)` | | foreground | `oklch(21.03% base hue)` | `oklch(99.11% base hue)` | | surface | `oklch(100% 0.53×base hue)` | `oklch(21.03% 2×base hue)` | | surface-secondary | `oklch(95.24% 0.8×base hue)` | `oklch(25.70% 1.53×base hue)` | | accent | `oklch(62.04% 0.195 hue)` | same | | success / warning / danger | HeroUI semantic hues, rotated by `12%` of the accent hue delta | same | Radii: HeroUI component tokens use `3×` (cards), `2.5×` (tabs), `2× + 6px` (popovers) and a separate form radius. DSH's semantic scale is `xs 0.5× / sm 1× / md 1.5× / lg 2× / xl-panel 3×`, so native rows, menus and cards keep their intended proportions. ## Brand layer On top of the generated tokens, `src/hero.css` adds the recognizable HeroUI details: - **Gradient primary actions** — accent → `accent + 31.67°` (blue → violet at the default) with a soft glow. - **Aurora wash** — accent/violet gradients on the conversation canvas and sidebar. - **HeroUI surfaces** — composer and dialogs use the card radius; Dropdown/Select menu popovers use the 22px dropdown radius. Bubbles, selected sessions, menus and overlays never show the page through. - **HeroUI controls** — 36px secondary buttons with the 0.97 press scale, a sliding-indicator Tabs switch for the theme, and a Select with a rotating chevron, 150ms scale/fade popover, 100ms exit and a stroke-drawn check. - **HeroUI sliders** — 20px track with 12px end caps, a 28×20 accent thumb and a 24×16 inner face; an invisible native range input keeps pointer, keyboard and aria semantics. - **Motion** — button `scale(0.97)`, popover/dialog/tooltip enter scales, 2s skeleton shimmer, user-message entrance; all disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`. ## Install ```sh # DSH Web dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-hero-theme # DSH Desktop dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-hero-theme ``` Or install manually into the Web profile: ```sh cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web pnpm add dsh-hero-theme ``` Add `"dsh-hero-theme"` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in that profile's `package.json` and restart the profile. Then open **Settings → General → HeroUI theme**. Drag Accent/Base/Radius/Radius Form, choose a font and theme; every change applies immediately and is saved into the active profile's Cordis patch. **Reset** returns to the builder defaults. ## How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Profile Config
6 volatile fields] --> B[src/palette.js] B --> C[167 tokens
light + dark] C --> D[ctx.theme.overrideTokens] D --> E[DSH Web / Desktop UI] ``` 1. The Host declares six volatile Config fields: `theme`, `accentHue`, `baseChroma`, `fontFamily`, `radius`, `fieldRadius`. 2. The browser half reads that config and calls `buildAllTokens()` to generate both light and dark palettes. 3. The result is applied as one `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` layer; `ctx.theme.setTheme(config.theme)` switches the built-in base scheme. 4. The settings row writes each field through ConfigForms (range writes are debounced by 180ms). 5. An external change to the built-in Appearance row is adopted into `theme`, so reloads keep the same appearance. The override disposer is deferred with `queueMicrotask` so removing the layer never re-enters the `theme/change` dispatch. ## Platform compatibility `dsh-hero-theme` is a Web client plugin (`dsh.client.platform: "web"`). DSH Desktop embeds the Web application, so the theme applies there through the Web client plugin loader; Desktop has its own profile. This package styles the embedded workspace only — it does not add native menu, tray, or window-shell UI. Requires DSH `^0.2.2-rc.1`. ## Develop ```sh npm run build # regenerates lib/client.js + lib/index.js npm run check # build, syntax, API contract, palette and contrast checks ``` `src/palette.js` is the single source of truth for colors, radii and fonts. It is injected into the client bundle at build time; its default output is covered by contrast and token-set checks. ## Repository layout ``` dsh-hero-theme/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client manifest ├── cordis.patch.yml # loader entry insert (id: dsh-hero-theme) ├── src/ │ ├── index.js # Host Config schema (six volatile fields) │ ├── palette.js # HeroUI v3 palette generator │ ├── client.tpl.js # browser half: builder row + token application │ └── hero.css # brand gradient, aurora, opaque surfaces, motion ├── scripts/ │ ├── build.mjs # zero-dependency build │ └── check-compat.mjs # DSH API, palette, contrast and CSS contract ├── .github/asset/ # README banner and preview renders ├── LICENSES/ # Apache-2.0 text for the HeroUI-derived material └── lib/ # generated artifacts (rebuilt on install/pack) ``` ## Attribution and license The plugin code is MIT-licensed (see [LICENSE](LICENSE)). Design tokens and interaction values are derived from **HeroUI**, which is Apache-2.0 licensed; see [NOTICE](NOTICE) and [LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt](LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt). This is an independent theme. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by HeroUI.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-plugin-suggest-bar —— 输入框上方「建议」栏

回合结束后，用一次异步小调用预测用户接下来可能说的话（**最多 3 条，卡上可循环切换**），显示在输入框上方；点「采用」填入输入框、「发送」直接发出、✕ 本回合不再弹。模型没把握时输出 `NONE`，本回合不出卡。两段式体验（回复先到手、建议异步补弹）在**所有 dsh 会话**的补齐实现（对自带建议能力的会话，默认跳过）。

![回合结束，输入框上方出现下一句建议](assets/screenshot-1.png)

![设置页可选 provider、模型与思考档位](assets/screenshot-2.png)

## 和同类插件怎么选

dsh 插件列表里还有两个做同一件事的插件。下表按**各自仓库里的实现**核对，不是按各自主页自述；三个都能装、都能用，差别在取舍。

|  | 本插件 | ChuanTianML/prompt-for-me | FurinaLiF/dsh-tab-complete |
|---|---|---|---|
| 一次调用产出几条候选 | **最多 3 条** | 1 条 | 1 条 |
| 换一条的代价 | 本地翻页，**不重新调模型** | 重新请求模型 | 没有备选可换 |
| 采用方式 | 点「采用」填入 | 点 ✓ / Tab / → 填入 | **只能 Tab** |
| 直接发出 | 点「发送」 | 不代发（设计如此） | 不代发 |
| 手机端 | 采用/发送/关闭都能点 | 能点 ✓ 和 ✦ | **用不了**（没有 Tab 键） |
| 思考档位 | 可选，且能「测试」探测支持哪档 | 写死 `off` | 无 |
| 与原生建议撞车 | `skipProviders` 可跳过 | 无 | 无 |
| 代码量 | 61.7 KB / 1283 行 | 108.6 KB / 2665 行 | **25.5 KB / 548 行** |
| 测试 | host 行为 21 条 + client 接线契约 9 条；渲染/交互未覆盖 | 5 个测试文件（含 client） | 2 个测试文件（含 client） |
| 分发 | GitHub 源码 | GitHub Release tarball + npm | GitHub 源码 |

### 我们不如它们的地方

- **client 侧只测了接线契约。** 卡片渲染、打字折叠、1/3 轮播、点击这些行为仍靠手测——那层要真 React + DOM，本次刻意没引入。
- **比 tab-complete 重 2.4 倍。** 如果只要「灰字补全 + Tab 填入」这一个功能，那个更合适。
- **「发送」是取舍，不是纯优点。** 两个竞品都刻意不代发（prompt-for-me 明写 never sends a message automatically）。我们少一步确认，也少一道保险。
- **交互细节没 prompt-for-me 细。** 它有 Esc 关闭、清空草稿自动复现、把跳过的候选回喂给模型避免重复；这些我们没做。
- **它发了 npm 包和预构建 tarball**，装的时候不用等构建。

### 我们确实更强的地方

- **一次调用给 3 条，翻页不花钱。** 卡上一次显示一条（`1/3` 按钮切换），想换个说法不用再等一轮模型；竞品换一条要重新请求。
- **手机上能完整操作。** 采用、发送、关闭全是点击；tab-complete 依赖 Tab 键，手机上根本没有这个键。
- **思考档位可选并带探测。** 点「测试」真发一次极短请求，把该模型能用的档位写进配置，只测一次，省输出 token。
- **`skipProviders`。** 会话主模型属于指定 provider（默认 `claude-code`）时不生成，避免和会话自带的建议功能重复出卡。

## 文件清单

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | host 侧：监听 `session/event`（turn/end→fire-and-forget 生成；turn/start→作废旧建议）、注册表（落盘 suggestions.json）、三条 HTTP 路由、config.json 读写 |
| `client.js` | 浏览器侧：`conversation.input.dock` 槽渲染建议卡（打字折叠/清空展开）、`settings.section` 槽渲染设置面板、700ms 轮询 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 行 + **首启种子配置**（此后以 config.json 为准） |
| `package.json` | `dsh.bundle` / `dsh.client` 声明、peer 依赖 |
| `config.json` | **运行配置**（首启自动从种子生成；设置面板改的就是它） |

## 架构（两段式）

```
回合结束(turn/end completed)
  → host: 有界辅助 LLM 调用（输入=最近几轮对话，含前 3 条用户消息；助手回复去噪后按预算截取 / 输出 1–3 行各≤120字，`NONE`=不出卡 / 思考档位：设置里测过就直接用，否则按模型能力自动取最省一档，兜底 off→low→不传）
  → 按行解析成 1–3 条 → 存注册表（会话id → {turn, texts[]}），500ms 防抖落盘 suggestions.json（最多 200 个会话）
  → 浏览器每 700ms POST /api/suggest-bar 读取
  → 输入框上方渲染建议卡（跑动中/打字中/已关闭 → 折叠）
用户发消息(turn/start)
  → 旧建议立即作废 + 中止在途生成
```

## 生成路由

- 路由候选：**config.json 配置的 provider+model 优先**（在设置面板里选），失败回退**继承会话当前路由**
- `skipProviders`（默认 `[claude-code]`）：会话主模型属于这些 provider 时不生成（这些会话通常自带原生建议，避免双份）

## 路由（connection.fetch）

| 路由 | 方法 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/suggest-bar` | POST `{sessionId}` | 读当前建议（回合运行中返回 null） |
| `/api/suggest-bar/config` | POST（空体=读，带字段=合并写） | 设置面板读写 config.json |
| `/api/suggest-bar/options` | POST | 枚举 `llm.listProviders()`/`listModels()`（设置下拉） |

## 设置（dsh 设置页 → 「建议栏」节）

provider（下拉识别）/ 模型（下拉联动）/ 标签文案 / **思考档位**（自动探测 ｜ off ｜ low ｜ 不传，旁边有「测试」按钮：真发一次极短请求，依次试 off / low / 不传，把该模型能用的档位写进配置，只需测一次）/ 跳过的 provider / **生成时机**（每次都生成 ｜ 仅对话在前台时，切走不生成、回来自动补一次）/ 总超时 / 输出 token 上限 / 每条建议最大字符数 / 启用 / 调试日志。**改动下一回合生效**（每回合现读 config.json）。

**去噪前缀**（`stripLinePrefixes`，手改 config.json）：助手回复里以这些字符串开头的行，在拼输入前丢掉。默认 `[]`，即不丢任何行。如果你的记忆或上下文系统会在回复中插入引用标记行，把那一行开头的固定字符串填进来，就能省下输入预算。

## 已知特性与限制

- 生成延迟取决于设置面板所选的 provider/模型；生成在回合结束后异步进行，不阻塞主对话
- 建议持久化在插件目录 `suggestions.json`，host 重启后恢复（刻意不写会话日志——自定义事件类型会让宿主事件校验拒载整本日志）
- 打字时建议卡折叠（0.35s 动画），清空草稿自动展开；✕ 只对本回合生效

## 测试

```sh
npm install   # 只装 devDependencies（@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm / schemastery），跑测试用
npm test
```

分两层，都不需要额外依赖：

- **host 侧 21 条**：假装一个 ctx → 发会话事件 → 读路由返回什么。断言的都是外部能观察到的结果（路由返回、`llm.stream` 有没有被调用、落盘文件内容），不贴内部实现。
- **client 侧 9 条**：用假 `react` 把 `client.js` 求值出来，验证与宿主客户端的接线契约——`__ModuleLoader__` 形态、导出的 `apply`/`inject`、注册了哪两个槽位及其 `id`/`order`、没有 `sessionId` 时不渲染。**这一层不渲染组件**，所以测不到渲染和交互。

假 `react` 的 hooks 被设计成「一旦被调用就抛错」，防止组件体在求值阶段被意外执行时测试还静悄悄通过。

数据目录默认就是插件目录；测试会把 `SUGGEST_BAR_DATA_DIR` 指到临时目录，所以不会读到也不会写坏真实的 `config.json` / `suggestions.json`。

client 侧（浏览器）还没有测试，目前靠手测。

## 排障

设置面板打开「调试日志」→ 复现一轮 → 看插件目录的 `debug.log`（`dbg()` 同时写 stdout 和该文件；DSH 的 stdout 走 supervisord 管道，读不到，所以落盘）。全链路探针（事件→转录→路由→每次尝试的耗时/失败原因→解析出的条数与文本）都在。收工后记得关回去。

## 版本
