# yumingtao-clarify-before-acting

A [DSH](https://www.dsh.so) bundle that installs the `clarify-before-acting` agent skill into
your DSH skill discovery root.

Resolve direction-changing ambiguity before acting on complex, ambiguous, or high-cost requests. Skips trivial, mechanical, low-risk tasks.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add yumingtao-clarify-before-acting
```

Or from the GitHub repository directly:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:yumingtao/agent-skills#path:/dsh-plugin/packages/clarify-before-acting
```

On first boot of the web profile the bundle copies the skill directory into
`~/.agents/skills` (the user-global skill root shared by DSH and Codex CLI).

## Force update

By default the installer skips the skill when its installed files are
byte-identical to the packaged ones. To force an overwrite, configure the row
with `force: true`:

```yaml
- id: yumingtao-clarify-before-acting
  name: 'yumingtao-clarify-before-acting'
  config:
    force: true
```

## License

MIT

# agent-skills

Original, platform-neutral agent skills — prompt assets that work across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Windsurf, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, CodeBuddy, and Hermes.

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![SkillHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/SkillHub-4%20published-green)](https://skillhub.cn/user/user_95900c57)
[![ClawHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/ClawHub-4%20published-orange)](https://clawhub.ai/@yumingtao)
[![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/yumingtao/agent-skills)](https://skills.sh/yumingtao/agent-skills)
[![DSH Index](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-market--index-blue)](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/yumingtao/agent-skills@main/docs/market/index.json)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

No runtime dependencies, no network calls, no build step. Each skill is a self-contained folder of instructions; where a skill supports multiple platforms, the platform files are thin adapters that route every agent to the same shared behavior.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| **[diagram-generator](skills/diagram-generator/)** | Turns architecture briefs and codebase notes into standalone HTML/SVG technical maps: system, implementation, infrastructure, trust, data movement, deployment, and process views. Full package: generation rules, planning IR, HTML template, validation script, per-platform smoke tests. |

```bash
# Option B — GitHub raw (always fresh, no CDN cache)
```

`sync/` is a generalized "one source → many platforms" distributor for the whole collection. A platform target receives the canonical skill folder as a symlink (default) or as a materialized copy.

- **One source of truth per skill.** Platform files route; they never restate behavior.
- **Markdown-first.** A skill is instructions plus optional specs/resources — nothing to install or run.
- **Progressive loading.** Coordinators stay thin; execution detail lives in `phases/` / `specs/` / `references/` loaded on demand.

## Roadmap

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add yumingtao-workflow-skill-designer
```

`~/.agents/skills` (the user-global skill root shared by DSH and Codex CLI).

## Force update

By default the installer skips the skill when its installed files are
byte-identical to the packaged ones. To force an overwrite, configure the row
with `force: true`:

```yaml
- id: yumingtao-workflow-skill-designer
  name: 'yumingtao-workflow-skill-designer'
  config:
    force: true
```

MIT

# agent-skills

Original, platform-neutral agent skills — prompt assets that work across Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Windsurf, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, CodeBuddy, and Hermes.

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![SkillHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/SkillHub-4%20published-green)](https://skillhub.cn/user/user_95900c57)
[![ClawHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/ClawHub-4%20published-orange)](https://clawhub.ai/@yumingtao)
[![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/yumingtao/agent-skills)](https://skills.sh/yumingtao/agent-skills)
[![DSH Index](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-market--index-blue)](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/yumingtao/agent-skills@main/docs/market/index.json)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

No runtime dependencies, no network calls, no build step. Each skill is a self-contained folder of instructions; where a skill supports multiple platforms, the platform files are thin adapters that route every agent to the same shared behavior.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| **[diagram-generator](skills/diagram-generator/)** | Turns architecture briefs and codebase notes into standalone HTML/SVG technical maps: system, implementation, infrastructure, trust, data movement, deployment, and process views. Full package: generation rules, planning IR, HTML template, validation script, per-platform smoke tests. |
| **[clarify-before-acting](skills/clarify-before-acting/)** | A behavior rule for non-trivial requests: do your own homework first, reuse answers already in memory, work a question queue one item at a time until every direction-changing unknown is resolved, and never guess where direction is at stake. |
| **[insight-challenge](skills/insight-challenge/)** | Adversarial verification of code-review findings. Challenges each claim with counter-evidence anchored to actual source code and emits structured verdicts — overturned / weakened / confirmed — instead of trusting findings as-is. |
| **[workflow-skill-designer](skills/workflow-skill-designer/)** | Meta-skill that designs orchestrator + phases workflow skills: a thin `SKILL.md` coordinator plus progressively loaded `phases/` files, with TodoWrite patterns, inter-phase data flow, and validation checklists. |
| **[defect-detective](skills/defect-detective/)** | Read-only triage — not a full debug loop — for a defect signal (bug report, stack trace, or log): normalize a stable fingerprint, search the issue tracker for duplicates cross-stack, correlate recent changes when the implicated layer is known, infer the owning team, and emit a structured verdict with a ready-to-paste ticket draft. Never files or mutates anything. |
| **[session-retrospective](skills/session-retrospective/)** | End-of-session review that extracts development-workflow issues (wrong answers, skipped gates, wrong routing, MCP errors, skill/doc gaps, multi-turn corrections) and appends priority- and recurrence-marked entries to a local feedback log — a recurring issue is a rule gap, and its priority escalates. Skips trivial clarifications, keeps only systemic signals. |

# dsh-daily-report · DSH 每日简报

把本机的 DSH 会话整理成一份能快速读完的简报：今天做了哪些事、用了多少 token、花了多少钱、哪里卡住、明天接着做什么，外加天气、dsh 启停时间和作息提醒。

[![CI](https://github.com/Yutai233/dsh-daily-report/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Yutai233/dsh-daily-report/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.3.0-blue)
![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)
![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-%E2%89%A5%200.2.2--rc.1-4A4AFF)
![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A5%2022.15-339933)

> **先读这段**：插件默认走 **B 档 · 仅标题 + 统计**，不调用任何模型，会话正文不出本机。报告里仍会包含会话标题、路径、命令和域名——分享前请自己检查。

## 特性

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 早晨卡片 | 点欢迎页鲸鱼可开合；新简报以小点＋摆尾提示，卡片自动适配可用高度；待续区默认显示前三条，其余滚动查看 |
| 三层日报 | 30 秒速览 / 约 3 分钟细读 / 附录（逐会话、命令、原始数据） |
| 正文摘要 | 会话先压缩成「事实包」，再写摘要；按会话与事件序号缓存，旧会话不重复花钱 |
| 工具统计 | 调用排行、失败次数、p50/p90 耗时、命令分类、改动文件、访问域名、审批等待 |
| 成本与省钱 | token 用量、花费估算、缓存命中率、峰谷占比、最贵一轮、每日预算提醒 |
| 近 7 天对比 | 指标带 ▲▼，7 天迷你柱状图默认折叠、点一下展开 |
| 卡点与待续 | 明日待续置顶在报告最前；未完成 todo 与中断记录的正文后附「相关会话」，在 DSH 内一键返回来源继续工作 |
| 每日意外发现 | 位于卡片与完整报告总览下；模型判断确实有依据、有新意才显示，不凑数；与总摘要合并请求，仅统计模式不显示 |
| 健康提醒 | Windows 键鼠空闲采样（可选），只提醒久坐、熬夜、午休没离开，不做医学判断 |
| 周报 / 月报 | 同一套数据换窗口，按 ISO 周与自然月聚合 |
| 给 agent 读 | Markdown 全量落盘，可选注册 `daily_report` 工具，直接问「昨天做了什么」 |

两条规则贯穿报告：**数字由代码计算，模型只负责写文字**；**没有变化的段落不渲染**。

## 界面预览

欢迎页鲸鱼 logo 上方弹出的早晨卡片（真实桌面截图）：

![早晨卡片](./docs/images/card-welcome.png)

日报与周报（由 `test/fixtures/sample-report.mjs` 的合成数据渲染）：

![日报（浅色）](./docs/images/demo-daily-light.png)

<details>
<summary>深色日报 / 周报</summary>

![日报（深色）](./docs/images/demo-daily-dark.png)

![周报](./docs/images/demo-weekly-light.png)

</details>

> 卡片图是真实桌面截图；其余三张由合成数据渲染（`node test/gen-docs-images.mjs` 可重新生成），不含任何真实会话内容，展示的是导出的报告页面本身，DSH 内的查看器还会套一层原生弹窗外壳。

## 安装

前置条件：DSH Desktop `>= 0.2.2-rc.1`。插件依赖 Host 的 `sessionQuery`、`connection`、`tools`、`systemPrompt` 服务。运行时零第三方依赖，只用 `node:*` 内置模块与全局 `fetch`。

本插件尚未发布到 npm，用下面的方式安装。

### 方式一：插件管理（推荐）

1. 克隆或下载本仓库，记下仓库根的绝对路径，例如 `E:\path\to\dsh-daily-report`
2. 打开 DSH 左侧 **插件** 页 → **添加插件**
3. 包名填入该绝对路径
4. 安装后点 **立即启用**；未开启 HMR 时重启 DSH
5. 打开 **设置 → 每日简报**，页面出现且 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-daily-report\` 开始产生数据即表示挂载成功

### 方式二：开发 link（命令行）

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Yutai233/dsh-daily-report.git
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" `
  plugin --profile desktop add "link:E:/path/to/dsh-daily-report"
```

移除时把 `add "link:..."` 换成 `remove dsh-daily-report`。不要手动复制进 `node_modules`，也不要用 `npm install` 安装。

> 仓库根就是插件包根（`package.json` 在根目录），所以 link 路径指向 clone 下来的仓库目录即可，不需要再进子目录。

## 使用

- **卡片与提示**：点新会话页鲸鱼可开合简报；有未查看简报时显示小点，并播放与悬停相同的摆尾动效。打开卡片后暂停自动提示，悬停动效保留；系统开启「减少动态效果」时仅保留小点。
- **明日待续**：小卡片和完整报告展示相同的待续内容与来源。小卡片默认完整显示前三条，在待续列表内滚动查看其余条目；窗口较矮时，整个内容区也可滚动。
- **继续工作**：待续条目带有来源时，点「相关会话」回到 DSH 原会话。旧归档若未保存会话 ID，不显示无效按钮；系统浏览器中的离线报告也不提供此跳转。
- **完整报告**：「查看完整报告」在 DSH 内打开查看器，也可打开 Markdown 或用系统浏览器查看
- **生成**：设置 → 每日简报 可生成日报、本周周报、本月月报并查看历史；默认每天 `09:00` 与首次打开各检查一次
- **问 agent**：「昨天做了什么」「上周三我修了什么」，或直接读 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-daily-report\reports\**\*.md`

## 隐私

| 档位 | 配置值 | 正文是否离开本机 | 行为 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **B · 仅标题 + 统计**（默认） | `local-only` | 否 | 不调用模型，会话摘要由标题、改动文件、失败、待办等事实拼成模板句 |
| A · 云端模型摘要 | `cloud` | 是 | 把压缩后的事实包发给 DSH 默认模型或指定模型 |
| C · 本地模型摘要 | `local-model` | 否（默认强制回环） | 发给本机 OpenAI 兼容服务（Ollama / LM Studio / llama.cpp） |

档位只由用户在设置页选择，插件不会自动切换，也不会在本地模型失败时改用云端。C 档默认只允许回环地址，需要局域网地址时必须显式打开 `allowLan`。分享报告前请自行检查：报告含会话标题、路径、命令与域名。

## 数据目录

```text
%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\dsh-daily-report\
├─ config.json / state.json
├─ heartbeat/  idle/  facts/  cache/
└─ reports/daily|weekly|monthly/
```

可用环境变量 `DSH_DAILY_REPORT_DIR` 覆盖数据根目录；在 **设置 → 每日简报 → 报告 → 报告保存目录** 输入绝对路径并点「保存目录」，或「恢复默认目录」。目录变更只切换报告读写位置，不搬移或删除旧报告，采样、事实和配置仍在原处。默认保留 180 天，`cache/` 与周报月报不会自动清理。DSH 原始会话日志仍在 `~/.dsh/sessions/`，插件只读不复制。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| [docs/GUIDE.md](./docs/GUIDE.md) | 完整使用说明、每个设置项、隐私细节、构建与冒烟脚本、已知边界 |
| [CONTRACT.md](./CONTRACT.md) | 数据契约：`DayFacts`、模块签名、`Report` 结构、渲染规则 |
| [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md) | 版本变更记录 |
| [docs/dev/](./docs/dev/) | 开发过程记录：功能设计方案、前期插件调研、阶段性交接说明（历史存档，部分内容可能已过时） |

## 开发

```powershell
node client/build.mjs                                  # 构建前端（改完 client/ 必跑）
node --test --test-timeout=300000 "test/*.test.mjs"     # 跑测试
```

改 `lib/**` 后重启 DSH；改前端后先重新构建 `client.js`，再把插件关掉重开（HMR 只在 `pnpm run dev:web` 时自动刷新）。`client/client.js` 是构建产物且随仓库提交，CI 会校验它与 `client-source.js` + `ui.css` + `fish-paths.js` 逐字节一致。

测试与冒烟脚本的细节见 [docs/GUIDE.md](./docs/GUIDE.md)，数据契约见 [CONTRACT.md](./CONTRACT.md)。

## 目录结构

```text
.
├─ lib/        Host 入口、配置、采集、摘要、分析、渲染
├─ client/     鲸鱼卡片、设置页、报告查看器（client.js 为构建产物）
├─ test/       测试、样例、真机冒烟脚本
├─ docs/       完整使用文档、截图、开发过程记录
└─ .github/    CI
```

## 已知边界

- 仅在 **Windows + DSH Desktop** 上验证；macOS/Linux 与其它 DSH 版本的兼容矩阵尚未验证
- 成本是**估算**，单价来自设置里可改的价目表，不是账单
- 健康提醒在未开键鼠采样时只用 DSH 消息时间粗估，文案会注明；不要把粗估说成实测
- Windows Toast 通知已实现并提交成功，但「用户是否真的看见」未实测
- 真实桌面逐按钮验收仍有缺口，详见 [docs/GUIDE.md](./docs/GUIDE.md) 的「已知边界」

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-toolshed 工具棚 **DeepSeek Harness 的工具面管理插件：MCP 服务、Skills、已归档会话，外加宿主重启 —— 一个侧边栏入口搞定。** [![dsh-toolshed](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh--toolshed-DSH%20plugin-4d6bfe.svg)](https://github.com/z1lyA/dsh-toolshed) [![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.9-3178c6.svg?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](https://www.typescriptlang.org/) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Web%20%7C%20Desktop-lightgrey.svg)](https://github.com/z1lyA/dsh-toolshed) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg?logo=opensourceinitiative&logoColor=white)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT) [Issues](https://github.com/z1lyA/dsh-toolshed/issues) • [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) • [English](README_EN.md) • Fork 自 [functy23/dsh-mcp-studio](https://github.com/functy23/dsh-mcp-studio)
--- > **为什么改名**：早期它是上游 `dsh-mcp-studio` 的 fork（只做 MCP / Skills）；后来并入了 > [z1lyA/dsh-session-admin](https://github.com/z1lyA/dsh-session-admin) 的已归档会话管理与桌面进程级重启， > 功能面与身份都变了，npm 上的 `dsh-mcp-studio` 又属原作者、发不了同名包，于是以 **`dsh-toolshed`** 独立立项 > （插件 id / 路由前缀 / 产物 id 全部换成新名，旧版需卸载后重装）。上游 MIT 与附加条款继续适用，见 > [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。 ## 📦 这是什么 Tauri 桌面版（[deepseek-harness-desktop](https://github.com/dsh-tauri-desk/deepseek-harness-desktop)）的扩展面板功能原本分散在**三个互相依赖的插件**里： | 上游包 | 作用 | 依赖 | | --- | --- | --- | | `dsh-tauri-panel-extension` | 扩展面板本体：**Skills / MCP / 插件市场** 三个 tab + host 路由 | `dsh-tauri`、`dsh-tauri-ui` | | `dsh-tauri` | 宿主/客户端框架桥：`defineRoutes`、`defineService`、`definePanel`、`defineRegister`、locale、store | — | | `dsh-tauri-ui` | 面板用的组件库：Button/Chip/Modal/SegmentedControl/PanelPage/图标… | `dsh-tauri` | 要装 MCP 管理，就得把这三个一起装上，而且只在 Tauri 发行版里可用。 **dsh-toolshed 把它们整合成一个包**：上游源码原样搬运（`src/panel`、`src/vendor/dsh-tauri`、`src/vendor/dsh-tauri-ui`）， 用构建期模块映射（`src/bridge`）把旧的裸包名 `dsh-tauri` / `dsh-tauri/client` / `dsh-tauri-ui/client` 指到本地文件， 再补上通用化所需的最小改造 —— **界面本身一行 UI 都没重写**。 ## ✨ 整合方式 ``` src/ ← 活代码：从产物入口走得到的部分 ├── panel/ ← dsh-tauri-panel-extension（原样搬运）+ 1.1.0 的会话管理 │ ├── host/ service（mcp / skills / agents / repos / restart / rmtree │ │ / archive / pending-deletions / session-paths / session-attachments / restart-helper）、 │ │ routes（mcp / skill / import / roots / archive / host） │ ├── client/ components（mcp-tab / mcp-editor-form / mcp-import-dialog / skills-tab │ │ / archive-tab / restart-control / extension-panel）、 │ │ register（extension-panel / skill-creator-prefill / styles）、locales、styles、store、apis │ └── shared/ ├── vendor/ │ ├── dsh-tauri/ ← dsh-tauri（host 框架工具 + client 框架桥；Tauri 专属的 invoke/iframe 桥保留但不进产物） │ └── dsh-tauri-ui/ ← dsh-tauri-ui（面板用到的组件与样式工具） └── bridge/ 构建期模块映射：旧裸包名 → 本地源码 vendor-archive/ ← 走不到产物入口的 vendor 子树（Tauri 专属桥、未搬运模块的测试） 不参与构建 / typecheck / 测试，只作上游对照 skills/ ← 随包发布的技能（host 半按 package.json 的 files 一起带上） skill-creator/ 「新建技能」预填的 /skill-creator 靠它成立，见下 find-skills/ 与上游发布产物逐字节相同 ``` 产物三个文件：`lib/index.js`（host 半，ESM）、`lib/client.js`（client 半，DSH ModuleLoader CJS）与 `lib/restart-helper.js`（重启助手，**独立进程**跑：拉起它的 Host 随后会被 taskkill，内联进主 bundle 就会一起消失）。 ### 通用化改造（三处适配 + 行为修复） 1. **模块映射**：`dsh-tauri`、`dsh-tauri/client`、`dsh-tauri-ui/client` → `src/bridge/*`，因此上游源码**不需要改 import**。 2. **profile 探测**（`src/panel/host/service/profile.ts`）：上游只认 `--profile` 开关（Tauri 壳会传）， 嵌入 Web / Desktop 后必须补上 `DSH_PROFILE` / `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` / 启动参数里的 `/profiles/`， 否则 MCP 行会写错 profile。 3. **独立标识**：插件 id 与路由前缀为 `dsh-toolshed`（`/dsh-toolshed/api/*`），与 Tauri 版插件、以及上游 `dsh-mcp-studio` 都不同，可共存互不覆盖。 可与 Tauri 版共存、互不覆盖。 此外还有面板行为修复（依赖新版核心的导航能力变化，见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)）： 4. **「新建技能」开新对话**：上游只走「工作区 → `connectWorkspace` 开新会话」，而 0.1.7 起导航搬到了 `uiWorkspace`。 现在按四级退级：官方 `sessions.create({ workspaceId })` 在**当前会话所属工作区**新建一条对话 → 适配层投影回的 `workspaces.connectWorkspace` → 会话不属于任何工作区时按它的 `cwd` 建 → 实在无处可建才复用活跃会话。 点一次「新建技能」不再抢走你正在写的那条对话。 5. **随包技能 `skills/`**：`/skill-creator` 是一条**技能**，不是内置命令——宿主只把技能目录里真实存在的条目 认成 `/名字`。上游用 `files: ["skills"]` 打包了 anthropics/skills 的 `skill-creator` 与 vercel-labs/skills 的 `find-skills`，本仓库按上游发布产物逐字节补回；缺了它，输入框里预填的 `/skill-creator` 就是普通文本： 不高亮、点不开、发送后也不会加载任何技能。 6. **插件市场收编已移除（1.2.0）**：上游用 iframe（`window.parent !== window`）才收编 `dshmarket`，那是给 Tauri 壳用的； 1.0.5 起本插件改成「只要 `dshmarket` 发布 `render` 就嵌进市场 tab」，1.2.0 起**整段移除**—— 市场是独立插件、低频，占用面板标签页不划算；装了 `dshmarket` 就继续用它的设置页入口。 Tauri 专属部分（`dsh-tauri/client` 的 invoke / listen / iframe 消息桥、桌面侧边栏注入）**保留在 vendor 里但不被引用**， 所以产物不会访问 `window.__TAURI__`，在 Web 与 Desktop 上同样工作。 ## 🚀 安装 装到你想用的那个 profile 上： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-toolshed@latest # DSH Web 版（尚未发 npm 时用下面的 link 方式） dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-toolshed@latest # DSH 桌面版 ``` 包内声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，安装即自动挂载；host 半更新后重启一次 DSH，然后硬刷新浏览器（Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R）。 > **关于 `dsh.client.platform: web`**：这里的 `web` 指**客户端类型**（Web GUI），不是 profile 名字。 > Web 与 Desktop 两个 profile 跑的都是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`，同一个客户端，所以两端都能用； > 本插件的客户端半依赖它的官方模块（ui-layout / ui-primitives / ui-renderer / locale）。 > > **Tauri 版不在范围内**：Tauri 发行版有自己的原生扩展面板插件。本仓库只是把那三个包搬过来整合成 > 跨端插件，产物里没有任何 Tauri 运行时依赖，也不反过来替换 Tauri 版的原生插件。 > **不要与 `dsh-session-admin` 同时安装**：1.1.0 已包含它的全部能力（已归档删除、待删除队列、进程级重启）。 > 两个插件会同时读改写同一个 `$DSH_HOME/session-admin/pending-deletions.json`，并重复注册 `workspace` 域的 > `domain/changed` 监听。升级步骤：先把本包装成 `link:` 并确认新 tab 正常，再卸载旧插件 > （`plugin_manager({ action: "remove_bundle", target: "dsh-session-admin" })`；若报 `bundle-in-use`， > 先从 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 去掉它、再删 `dependencies` 里的 `link:` 项，最后 > `pnpm install --offline --dir ` 收敛 lockfile）。 本地开发（link）： ```sh pnpm install && pnpm build # ~/.dsh/profiles//package.json # "dependencies": { "dsh-toolshed": "link:/abs/path/to/dsh-toolshed" } # "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ ..., "dsh-toolshed" ] } } pnpm install --dir ~/.dsh/profiles/ ``` ## 🧭 界面 装好后侧边栏出现 **工具管理**（Puzzle 图标），点开是三个 tab，标签页那一行的**最右侧**是刷新 + 重启服务： | Tab | 能力 | | --- | --- | | **技能** | 技能列表（按来源分组）、搜索、启用 / 停用、查看与编辑 SKILL.md、新建技能（在当前工作区开一条新对话并预填 `/skill-creator`）、删除、打开目录、刷新 | | **MCP** | 服务器列表（项目级 / 全局、启用状态、传输方式、URL / 命令）、新增与编辑表单、启用 / 停用、连接检查、复制片段、从其他 DSH profile 或 Claude / Cursor / Windsurf / VS Code 配置**导入扫描**、JSON 导出导入；写入后提示「需要重启」 | | **会话** | 已归档会话列表（工作区、精确磁盘占用、文件数、子代理数）、全选 / 半选 / 单选、批量**取消归档**、批量**永久删除**（dry-run 计划 → 确认 → 执行）、**待删除**队列与取消 | | **右上角重启控件** | 刷新（重新判断能否重启）+ 重启服务（进程级）。不可重启时按钮禁用，鼠标悬停即显示原因：有运行中的会话 / 排队输入 / 后台任务，或当前不是桌面应用 | > 1.2.0 起**不再收编插件市场**：即使装了 `dshmarket`，也由它自己的设置页入口提供；本面板只保留技能 / MCP / 已归档。 技能启停沿用上游策略：写 SKILL.md 的 `user-invocable` 策略位，不新增旁路状态。 ### 🗂 已归档会话管理 DSH 只提供归档 / 取消归档，**没有删除会话的接口**。这个 tab 把缺失的那一步补上，并把边界条件做成显式规则： - 只有注册表里处于**归档态**的会话能被操作；id 走路径白名单（`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,199}$`）。 - **仍在内存里的会话不强删**：Host 只要打开过一条会话就持有 Agent 句柄，此时删日志会让后端重建无 header 的日志。 这类会话（含它们的 subagent 派生子会话）被登记到 `$DSH_HOME/session-admin/pending-deletions.json`， **下次 DSH 启动时**在浏览器打开会话之前执行；页面显示「待删除」并支持随时取消。 - 删除范围：整棵会话日志目录 `sessions///`（绝不截断 zstd 日志）、 投影缓存 `storages/session_projcache/sessions/.json`、绑定到该会话的定时任务、工作区槽位与归档墓碑。 - **附件（可选，默认开）**：先读被删会话事件得到候选 `sha256:` 对象，再扫描其余全部会话事件 + `$DSH_HOME/llm-deepseek/files-v3.json` 上传索引；只删除**没有任何剩余引用**的对象。 扫描不完整（读失败 / 超预算）时**一个附件都不删**，并在结果里报告原因。 - 取消归档会立刻清掉该会话的待删除意图（监听 workspace 域的 `domain/changed`，页面每次读取也会兜底清理）。 - 已知限制：删除后本页会刷新，但原生侧栏的会话列表可能残留到下一次页面刷新 / 重启； 多开实例时 JSON 存储域是「最后写入者获胜」，建议单实例操作。 ### 🔄 右上角重启控件 重启是**进程级**实现（DSH 没有给插件暴露重启接口）：先检查工作区里运行中的回合、排队中的输入、 running / stopping 的后台 job（**已归档会话豁免**），有交叉就把按钮**禁用**并在 `title` 里列明原因 （悬停即见）；无交叉时点击 → 一次确认弹窗 → 写重启计划、拉起脱离进程树的助手 `lib/restart-helper.js`、HTTP 回复后 `taskkill /T` 当前 Electron 进程树，助手等旧进程退出、 单实例锁释放后以 GUI 方式重拉同一个可执行文件，页面在宿主恢复后自动重载。日志在 `$DSH_HOME/session-admin/restart.log`。 左侧的刷新按钮会重新拉一次 `GET /api/host/restart`：结束掉阻塞的会话/任务后点一下，按钮就恢复可用。 **只在 DSH 桌面应用里可用**（判据：`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` + argv 含 `dsh-desktop-host` + 有父进程）； Web / CLI 会如实显示「不可用」。重启会中断当前回合，请先确认没有正在进行的对话。


## 🌐 HTTP API 面板的客户端半与脚本共用同源路由（沿用上游的安全闸门：变更方法要求本机回环来源、`Origin` 与 `Host` 不符直接 403）： | 方法 | 路径 | | --- | --- | | GET | `/dsh-toolshed/api/skills`、`/api/mcp`、`/api/skill?name=`、`/api/roots`、`/api/import/scan`、`/api/archived`、`/api/host/restart` | | POST | `/api/mcp`、`/api/mcp/toggle`、`/api/mcp/check`、`/api/mcp/copy`、`/api/skills/refresh`、`/api/skill`、`/api/skill/policy`、`/api/import/apply`、`/api/roots`、`/api/open/dir`、`/api/host/restart`、`/api/archive/plan`、`/api/archive/unarchive`、`/api/archive/pending/cancel` | | DELETE | `/api/mcp`、`/api/skill`、`/api/roots`、`/api/archive` | `defineRoutes` 按 `(kind, path)` 收敛，同一路径的多个方法只占一行 `webServer.register`：1.1.0 起共 **18** 行。 错误体统一是 `{ error, code }`（重启被挡住时多一个 `blockers` 数组），面板靠 `code` 分支。 ## 🛠 开发 ```sh pnpm install pnpm typecheck # tsc --noEmit，解析宿主真实类型（当前全绿） pnpm build # node scripts/build.mjs → lib/index.js + lib/client.js + lib/restart-helper.js pnpm test # node scripts/run-tests.mjs（vitest；见下方说明） ``` **远程仓库（本项目已脱离 fork 身份，是独立仓库）**： | remote | 指向 | 用途 | | --- | --- | --- | | `origin` | `z1lyA/dsh-toolshed` | 本项目主仓（独立，非 fork） | | `upstream` | `functy23/dsh-mcp-studio` | 只读参考：上游框架层的修复可以 `git cherry-pick` 过来 | | `fork-archive` | `z1lyA/dsh-toolshed-fork` | 改名/脱离前的 fork 备份，确认不再需要后可删 | > 本仓库**没有 CI**：验证依赖 DSH 宿主与 macOS 签名，跑在干净 runner 上只能验一半， > 所以 `typecheck` / `test` / `build` 一律以本地为准。 > `pnpm test` 不是裸 `vitest run`：vite 加载的 rollup 原生绑定既没签名，DSH 自带 Node 又带 > hardened runtime，两处都会让 `dlopen` 失败。包装脚本 `scripts/run-tests.mjs` 会先补一次 ad-hoc 签名， > 再挑一个不带 hardened runtime 的 Node 跑 vitest（找不到会给出下一步）。 > > 旧裸包名的映射共三处，改一处要三处同改：`scripts/build.mjs`（esbuild alias）、`tsconfig.json`（paths）、 > `vitest.config.ts`（resolve.alias）。 > 构建用 **esbuild**：DSH 运行时的 Node 开启了 macOS 库验证（library validation）， > rollup/rolldown 的 `.node` 绑定因 Team ID 不同会 `dlopen` 失败。详见 [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)。 ## 🙏 鸣谢 - **[deepseek-harness-desktop](https://github.com/dsh-tauri-desk/deepseek-harness-desktop)**（Tauri 桌面版，作者 Hairyf 与贡献者）—— 本项目搬运的 `dsh-tauri-panel-extension`、`dsh-tauri`、`dsh-tauri-ui` 三个包全部来自该仓库， **界面、交互与 host 服务逻辑均为其原始实现**；没有它就没有这个插件。请优先支持上游与 Tauri 桌面版。 - **[z1lyA/dsh-session-admin](https://github.com/z1lyA/dsh-session-admin)** —— 「已归档」tab 与面板右上角的进程级重启 移植自该插件（含删除边界规则、待删除队列与桌面进程级重启）；原始 MIT 许可与改动说明见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。 - 官方插件开发文档： ## 📄 License MIT（见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)）。搬运的上游代码同样以 MIT 发布，并附带 [Additional Terms — No Commercial Secondary Development](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)： **不得用于商业性二次开发**，本项目亦以非商业开源形式分发。

evidence.readmeExcerpt: # dsh-zcontext Model-driven incremental context folding for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) — the model folds finished stretches of a conversation into short summaries it writes itself, keeping the working window small over very long sessions, through the official surface-replace channel only. - **What it is** — a third-party plugin package (`dsh-zcontext`) for the official DeepSeek Harness: four tools (`zctx_fold` / `zctx_unfold` / `zctx_recall` / `zctx_status`), one static guidance section, one pressure nudge, one `/zctx` command, an always-on observability ledger, an opt-in-able preflight gate, and an opt-in zctx router for your own providers — all surfaced through one settings page (nine primitive fields plus the v0.2.0 sections below). No host patches, no forks; the only wire-facing face is the declared S2 router, which never rewrites a request body. - **Why it exists** — the official harness ships compaction-basic, which summarizes the whole window under pressure; it has no model-driven incremental folding. The [billion-context](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context) research demonstrated the mechanism (model writes summaries, model picks ranges, cache-aware nudges, sessions run long with low window occupancy). This plugin reimplements that capability through the official plugin surface — the same mechanism, the harness's own proper channel. - **Clean-room** — zero code or prompt text was copied from billion-context or any upstream source. All code and all model-facing text in this repository are original writing; the guidance section is our own wording. See [Acknowledgments](#acknowledgments). ## Table of contents - [How it works](#how-it-works) - [Install](#install) - [The four tools](#the-four-tools) - [The /zctx command](#the-zctx-command) - [Relation to official compaction](#relation-to-official-compaction) - [Observability ledger (installed = recording)](#observability-ledger) - [Preflight (S1): judge the window before the wire](#preflight-s1) - [zctx router (S2): bring-your-own providers, honestly](#zctx-router) - [Settings](#settings) - [Behavior notes](#behavior-notes) - [Limitations](#limitations) - [Security](#security) - [Acknowledgments](#acknowledgments) - [Development](#development) ## How it works Folding replaces a span of earlier turns on the session surface with one short summary checkpoint. Everything rides the official surface-replace channel — the same primitive `compaction-basic` uses, which its types explicitly reserve for "any surface-replacing producer": 1. **Guidance** — a static, byte-stable system-prompt section teaches the model when to fold, what a summary must keep and drop, and the batch discipline. It never sets `complete: true` and carries no dynamic content, so it lands in the cached prompt prefix once and stays put. 2. **Nudge** — a runtime context fires when occupancy crosses 25/50/75/90% of the window (configurable). It contributes text only on a threshold crossing; between crossings it adds nothing to the wire (crossing-counted cache re-payment, not free). 3. **Fold** — the model calls `zctx_fold` with ranges + summaries. A conservative validator enforces: protected recent tail, first user message pinned, system head untouched, tool calls folded together with their results, net-shrink gate, atomic batch (any invalid range rejects the whole batch), no overlap with an active compaction. 4. **Ledger** — each fold commits a checkpoint event whose `message.source` carries `kind: 'zctx-fold'` (or `'zctx-unfold'`). There is **zero independent storage**: the fold ledger is rebuilt by scanning the session log, so resume and fork just work, and the original events stay in the log forever. 5. **Status** — `zctx_status` is the trusted ledger: window occupancy vs the fold trigger line, budget breakdown (CCM v2.3 formulas), foldable ranges with PROTECTED marks, active folds, anomalies, and cache usage (measured or estimated, labeled honestly). In v0.2.0 it renders the observability ledger in three segments (session summary, repay table behind the clean-sample gate, recent folds with attribution quality + reset digest). Cache economics are accounted, not hand-waved: the four tool schemas plus the guidance section are a fixed wire overhead; each fold or nudge crossing re-pays a prefix rebuild from the cache anchor. `zctx_status` shows the breakeven split between measured (provider-reported cache read/write) and estimated values. ## Install ```sh dsh plugin add github:zsagi1368/dsh-zcontext ``` Requirements: the DeepSeek Harness with plugin support, Node.js >= 22.13. The built artifact ships in the repository (`lib/`), so a git-form install never runs a build step and never asks for pnpm build approvals (`allowBuilds`). The only peer dependency is `@deepseek-ai/cordis` (optional, resolved from the host). After installing, the plugin appears in the settings page under its own section (static `Config` schema, the fields below), and `/zctx` becomes available in sessions. The observability ledger starts recording immediately; folding needs nothing else. ## The four tools All four are registered through the official `defineTool` authoring contract, take the official enforced schema subset, and return model-facing strings. Every failure is a fail-soft string result — nothing throws across the host boundary. ### `zctx_fold` One required string carries ALL ranges and summaries — one `fold .. [topic]` header line per block, followed by that block's markdown summary. The batch commits atomically or is rejected as a whole with reasons: ```json { "content": "fold 3..7 [file inventory]\nThe user asked for a file inventory; three files were listed (a.sql, b.ts, c.md) and a.sql identified as the largest. Inventory is complete.\nfold 12..15 [schema of a.sql]\nSchema of a.sql: two tables and one view; the view aggregates daily totals." } ``` A JSON array of `{ startRef, endRef, summary }` objects is also accepted (gateways that stringify arrays), as is a single top-level range object. Get exact ranges and pressure from `zctx_status` first. ### `zctx_unfold` Re-materializes one folded range back onto the surface in place of its checkpoint. Without arguments, the most recent active fold is unfolded: ```json { "foldId": "f0000007" } ``` ### `zctx_recall` Searches inside everything already folded — summaries and folded-away originals (the originals stay in the session log). Returns ranked hits with excerpts and the owning fold id, so folded history stays reachable without unfolding: ```json { "query": "schema a.sql view", "limit": 5 } ``` ### `zctx_status` No arguments. The single trusted ledger for pressure, budget, ranges, folds, anomalies, and cache usage — the model is instructed to never reconstruct these numbers from memory: ```json {} ``` ## The /zctx command The same engine, driven from the chat input: ```text /zctx status (default) /zctx status pressure, budget, ranges, folds, cache usage /zctx fold commit fold blocks (same content format as the tool) /zctx unfold [foldId] re-materialize a fold (latest active when omitted) ``` ## Relation to official compaction **Coexistence, never interception.** The official `compaction-basic` is never disabled, blocked, or delayed by this plugin. It remains the unconditional hard floor: if the model never folds (tool adoption is the model's choice), compaction still summarizes under pressure exactly as upstream designed. When an official compaction is actively running, a concurrent fold commit is rejected cleanly and retried later. Folding earlier and smaller is the intended division of labor — proactive folds keep the window small so the hard floor rarely has to fire. ## Observability ledger (installed = recording) The ledger starts recording the moment the plugin is installed — no opt-in needed (`observe.enabled: true` by default; see it through `zctx_status`). A strictly read-only `llm/stream` listener watches every attempt and keeps, in process memory: - **Request snapshots with normalized prefix hashes** — per-attempt views of what the wire actually saw, each row labeled with its projector provenance (the official projection exports when the host is present, a labeled local fallback otherwise). - **A reset-event ledger** — model change, sampling change, toolset change, system-section change, compaction, session recovery, series restart, merge rewrites: every "the context changed under us" event that explains a cache re-payment. - **Three-state usage accounting** — `measured` (provider-reported), `semi` (honestly upgraded: interpolated from a same-turn anchor, or meter-anchored), `estimated` (never guessed; a field that was absent stays absent). - **Fold→usage attribution** — seq-order primary key with a time-window fallback, strong/retry/weak grades, and eight documented noise dispositions (multi-step after folds, retries, interrupts, one-shots, and friends). `zctx_status` renders the whole ledger in three segments: the session summary, the repay table (behind the clean-sample gate — when the pure-sample ratio falls below `cleanSampleFloor` the status says attribution confidence is insufficient instead of showing numbers), and recent folds with their attribution quality plus the reset digest. Dual-domain honesty: harness-domain rows cover every watched session; wire-domain byte hashes exist only for sessions the zctx router drove (below). ## Preflight (S1): judge the window before the wire `preflightMode: 'off' | 'observe' | 'enforce'` — **default `'observe'`**. - **observe (default)** — a second read-only listener estimates each request's context before the wire (the official projection exports when the host is present, labeled fallback twins otherwise; kept images priced via the adapter's `imageRequestPricing` or a declared constant reserve) and records estimate-vs-real-usage into a calibration ledger that `zctx_status` renders as error statistics. Nothing is ever short-circuited in this mode. - **enforce (explicit opt-in)** — a hit (estimate > trigger line × `preflightMarginRatio`) short-circuits the stream with exactly one terminal `finish{kind:'error', failure:{code:'CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED'}}` chunk — the official sanctioned short-circuit — saving the doomed wire request; the official compaction overflow recovery chain owns everything after. One-shot requests (compaction, session title) are never judged, so the recovery's own calls can never be short-circuited. - **off** — the listener does not register. enforce stays opt-in until three migration conditions hold: the estimator's error distribution is calibrated on real machines, the false-positive cost (one unnecessary compaction surface rewrite per wrong hit) is consciously accepted, and observed hits reconcile with real provider overflows. Until then the estimator thresholds are declared calibration debt (see [Limitations](#limitations)). ## zctx router (S2): bring-your-own providers, honestly The one place v0.2.0 touches the wire — as a declared exception, not a takeover: a thin adapter that lets the harness drive **your own** OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible endpoints through the official configurable-provider surface. The official routes are never replaced, and the adapter **never rewrites a request body** (the zero-mutation redline is pinned by tests). - **family IS the protocol.** Each declared provider becomes the route `zctx-`, where `family` is a wire protocol name from the official `supportedProtocols()` union (`openai-completions` | `openai-responses` | `anthropic-messages`, loaded dynamically from the host with a labeled builtin fallback). Zero invented protocol mapping; an unknown family is refused at construction with the complete violation list. - **Configuration shape.** The structured `providers[]` settings section is the config authority, written by hand through a profile overlay patch. The Models page mounts the plugin's namespace and shows each route's row, credential badge, and error field — but page **editing is not available** for a third-party namespace (probe-tested; honest ceiling): the page is visibility-only. - **Every model declares its capacities.** `contextWindow` and `maxTokens` are REQUIRED positive integers per model — a missing value is a construction violation, never an invented default (official catalog semantics). - **Cache knobs.** `cacheRetention` (`'none' | 'short' | 'long'`) passes through to pi-ai's own precedence (explicit value > env > default `'short'`; `'none'` disables cache markers); `cacheControlFormat: 'anthropic'` materializes cache-control markers — only on the `openai-completions` family, refused anywhere else as dead config. - **Redlines honored.** `maxRetries: 0` (the agent recovery layer owns retries), attribution headers ride every request including one-shots, HTTP(SSE) protocols only (no WebSocket transport), text-only — image/file content blocks are refused before the wire. - **Wire ledger coverage.** Only sessions the router actually drives get wire-domain byte-hash rows; everything else stays harness-domain only, and every row carries its `domain` label. ## Settings Nine primitive fields plus the v0.2.0 sections (observe switches, preflight, and the S2 providers declaration); the static `Config` schema generates the settings page automatically. | Field | Type | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---|---| | `enabled` | boolean | `true` | Master switch. When `false` the plugin stays passive; official compaction remains the hard floor. | | `nudgeThresholds` | string | `"25,50,75,90"` | Comma-separated occupancy percentages that trigger a nudge. | | `keepRecentTokens` | number | `0` | Verbatim recent-tail token budget; `0` = automatic. | | `maxFoldFraction` | number | `0.6` | Upper bound on the fraction of the window a single fold may cover. | | `minFoldableTokens` | number | `5000` | Minimum foldable span in tokens below which folding is refused. | | `protectionFloorTokens` | number | `5000` | Tokens kept outside any fold window (protected recent tail). | | `summaryFloorChars` | number | `50` | Shortest acceptable summary text in characters. | | `summaryCeilingChars` | number | `20000` | Longest acceptable summary text in characters. | | `netShrinkTolerance` | number | `1.05` | A fold must shrink the ledger by at least `1/netShrinkTolerance`. | The v0.2.0 sections ride the same schema: | Field | Type | Default | Meaning | |---|---|---|---| | `attributionTimeWindowMs` | number | `90000` | Attribution time-window fallback (uncalibrated — see [Limitations](#limitations)). | | `cleanSampleFloor` | number | `0.6` | Below this pure-sample ratio, `zctx_status` reports insufficient attribution confidence instead of a repay table. | | `observe.enabled` | boolean | `true` | Master switch of the observability ledger (installed = recording). | | `observe.attemptCapture` | boolean | `false` | Also record failed attempts' usage (non-durable, process memory only). | | `preflightMode` | string | `"observe"` | `'off' \| 'observe' \| 'enforce'` — see [Preflight (S1)](#preflight-s1). | | `preflightMarginRatio` | number | `0.9` | Preflight hit margin (uncalibrated — see [Limitations](#limitations)). | | `providers` | provider[] | `[]` | S2 router declarations (see [zctx router](#zctx-router)); zero routes = the adapter face stays a legal keep-alive. Configured through a profile overlay patch. | Independent of these settings, the whole automatic face (nudge + engine gate) stays off below a context window of 32768 tokens — the estimation formulas' legal domain. Tools remain usable; status renders an explicit note. ## Behavior notes Three behaviors that are deliberate, not bugs: **PTC (run_code) sessions cannot call the tools directly.** In native tool mode, the model calls `zctx_*` tools first-class. In a PTC session, the official harness does not register direct model calls to third-party tools (they are rejected as `UNKNOWN_TOOL`), so there the tools are dispatched through `run_code` sub-dispatch. The guidance section carries this note for the model. Nothing about folding changes — only the calling convention differs by mode. **The nudge context registers with `required: true`.** The official system-prompt assembler filters out non-required context contributions in some configurations (e.g. runtime context suppressed). Registering the pressure nudge as required is what makes it survive that filter — without it, the nudge could silently vanish exactly when pressure is high. This does not mean the nudge is always on the wire: it contributes text only when a threshold is crossed since its last evaluation, and contributes nothing otherwise. **Unfold re-materializes as one node.** The official replace semantics swap N surface nodes for exactly one node. Unfolding therefore replaces the checkpoint with a single multi-block user message that quotes the original content inline (originals fetched from the log in order; tool results quoted with a source annotation) — the original turns do NOT return to the surface as separate messages. The session log keeps every original event permanently, and `zctx_recall` searches them, but the wire shape after an unfold differs from the pre-fold turn structure. This is the honest cost of riding the official channel, and it is asserted in tests rather than hidden. ## Limitations - **Tool adoption depends on the model.** Folding happens when the model follows the guidance and nudges. Weaker instruction-following means fewer folds — and the official compaction-basic remains the hard floor either way. - **No wire-level fallback.** Folding rides the official surface replace channel only. There is no request rewriting, no fetch proxy, no prompt-level truncation fallback; if the channel is unavailable, the plugin does not degrade to hacky alternatives. - **Cross-checkpoint absorption is boundary-aligned.** A fold window may absorb an earlier fold's checkpoint only when the window is exactly `[checkpoint, checkpoint]`; wider spans across a checkpoint are rejected with an explicit reason. - **Single-session scope.** `zctx_recall` and the ledger are per-session; no cross-session retrieval. - **Estimator thresholds are uncalibrated.** `attributionTimeWindowMs=90000`, `cleanSampleFloor=0.6`, and `preflightMarginRatio=0.9` are designed defaults awaiting real-machine calibration; the chars/3 estimator's underestimate risk on dense CJK text is the known hazard. `zctx_status` renders the calibration statistics that will justify adjusting them — until then, `preflightMode: 'enforce'` is opt-in advanced usage only. - **The wire-domain ledger sees only zctx-routed sessions, and object-level hashes are blind below the harness boundary.** Harness-domain normalized prefix hashes see harness events only — whatever pi-ai or the transport stack does below that boundary (serialization, provider-specific framing) is invisible to them; the wire-domain byte hashes see the real bytes but only where the S2 router drove the request. This is the honest ceiling of v0.2.0's observability, declared rather than papered over. ## Security - **Zero network, zero telemetry.** The plugin opens no sockets and emits no metrics anywhere; there is no analytics, no crash reporting, no phone-home. - **Session data stays local.** All folding state lives in the local session log (the harness's own storage). The plugin keeps zero independent data files; its in-memory ledger is rebuilt by scanning that log. - **Model-forgery defense.** The model cannot "claim" a fold that didn't happen: every submission is validated server-side (protected zones, contiguity, net-shrink gate, summary length windows, atomic batch), the commit goes through the harness's own session append, and the receipt the model sees is the native tool result — not model-rendered text. - **Exclusive fold commits.** None of the four tools declares `isConcurrencySafe`; omission is the official exclusive-barrier semantics, which is the mutual-exclusion precondition the commit path relies on. - **Fail-soft degradation.** Every host face is capability-probed; a missing service skips its feature with a log line instead of breaking boot. ## Acknowledgments This plugin is a clean-room reimplementation of a mechanism the community proved out: - [**ranxianglei/billion-context**](https://github.com/ranxianglei/billion-context) (MIT) — the mechanism inspiration: model-driven incremental folding, summaries-as-metadata discipline, cache-aware nudges, crossing-counted re-payment. This plugin thanks it for publishing the working design and its honest trade-offs. **No code, no prompt text, and no compression-rule wording was copied from it** — all text here is written from scratch; only the mechanism semantics were studied. - **Our own CCM research** (context-cache economics: budget formulas, breakeven accounting, the 32768-token legal domain) — the budget engine and status accounting follow it. All implementation, wording, tests, and documentation in this repository are original work (MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE)). ## Development ```sh pnpm install pnpm build # tsdown → lib/ (committed artifact, byte-pinned in CI probes) pnpm lint # tsc --noEmit, zero errors expected pnpm test # vitest suite (424 tests), incl. real official-session pins ``` Repository-internal verification probes: ```sh node scripts/probe-artifact.mjs # 6 probe groups against the built lib node scripts/verify-activation-surface.mjs # activation-surface assertions (10 groups) node scripts/probe-host-imports.mjs # host-export reachability (16 probes; skips when zDSH-main is absent) node scripts/smoke-real-loader.mjs # real-machine smoke (3 probes; skips parts when zDSH-main is absent) ```

decision.reason: Held for versioned DSH compatibility. MIT, own Git installation and a substantial native compiled entry are present. The plugin participates in context folding/recall and model-wire transformation. Node/cordis requirements do not establish a versioned DSH contract, and its internal host coupling remains a compatibility risk. No candidate code or lifecycle hooks were executed; runtime safety and compatibility are unproven.

fullManifest.description: dsh-decision-engine: a cheap judgement layer for DeepSeek Harness — a small decision model answers structured questions before the main model acts, so calls can be allowed, escalated, rerouted to a cheaper model, or skipped. All eight decision points (tool authorization, model routing, delegation, compaction, turn continuation, retrieval, skill pick, COT translation) are implemented and individually switchable. Works against any service exposing a decision endpoint: built-in presets (system one, bamboonode, SiliconFlow, Silicon Flow) or a custom base URL.

evidence.readmeExcerpt:
# dsh-decision-engine

![dsh-decision-engine — decision engine for DeepSeek Harness](docs/assets/hero.jpeg)

**Free decision model usage provided**

[website](https://dsh.zuos.us/dsh-decision-engine/) ·
[config.example.yml](config.example.yml) · [DECISIONS.md](DECISIONS.md)

[简体中文](./README.zh.md)

A judgement layer for DeepSeek Harness: a cheap decision model judges before the
main model acts.

## Features

**Eight decision points**

- tool authorization
- model routing
- delegation
- compaction
- turn continuation
- retrieval necessity
- skill selection
- COT translation gate

**Modes**: off · observe · enforce

**Providers**: system one · bamboonode · 硅基流动 SiliconFlow (CN / Global) ·
Perplexity · OpenRouter · custom base URL

**Review tolerance**: autonomous · relaxed · default · cautious

**UI**: config page with collapsible sections · Decisions tab · stats ·
readable approval card

| Config page | Decisions tab |
|---|---|
| ![config page](docs/assets/config-page.png) | ![decisions tab](docs/assets/decisions-tab.png) |

> Screenshots predate the collapsible-section layout (DEC-051).

**Token saving**: exact cache · read-only tools bypass · state trimming

**Reliability**: shadow by default · fail open on any error · timeout degrades ·
stats can be turned off

## License

MIT

manifest.name: dsh-bundle-headless-resume
manifest.description: [DEPRECATED] dsh bundle: replaces the stock headless one-shot runner with the --resume / --print-session-id variant. Superseded by upstream-native --session-id/--json in dsh >= 0.1.6-alpha.1; kept only for 0.1.0-rc.x-era installs.

patch.body:
# The headless-resume bundle: disable the stock one-shot pair and mount this
# package's variant, which adds --resume and --print-session-id. Layer after
# @deepseek-ai/dsh-headless in the profile's dsh.profile.bundles list.

- id: headless-startup
  disabled: true

- id: headless-runner
  disabled: true

- insert:
    - id: headless-resume-startup
      name: dsh-plugin-headless-resume/startup

    # Reads its task and session switches from the ordinary headlessStartup provider.
    - id: headless-resume-runner
      name: dsh-plugin-headless-resume
      inject: [headlessStartup]
      config:
        task: !!js ctx.headlessStartup.task
        resume: !!js ctx.headlessStartup.resume
        printSessionId: !!js ctx.headlessStartup.printSessionId === true

manifest.name: dsh-preset-codex-cua
manifest.description: 为 DSH 的 macOS Computer Use 提供 Codex 与 PTC 共用的开关：开启后所有 Agent 预设可用，关闭后恢复仅 PTC 可用。

patch.body:
# 覆盖官方 Computer Use 组合包插入的同 id 行。
# 不能加 insert：这里只改变已有 provider 的 agentPreset。
- id: cua
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-cua-macos'
  config:
    agentPreset: false
